✍️ Editorial & Opinion Paragraph #1 of 30 (24 NOV)

📰 Fatal disagreement: on the COP31 summit

📌 Published: 24 Nov 2026, 12:07:07 PM
🎙️ Desi Hinglish Voice Educator • 🚂 Live Train Line Highlight & Screen Lock

1. Core Context & Background: Developed nations must bear much of the cost of carbon emissions

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: COP31 ended in Antalya, Türkiye, with a whimper. The 190-odd countries that had convened for nearly 12 days — a close to 50-hour overshoot — failed to agree on an overarching political statement , called a cover text, that acts as a stepping stone to future, collective global action on climate change. Usually, cover texts evolve as a final synthesis of deliberations ; the COP31 leadership, helmed by Türkiye and Australia, thought it fit to push for a cover text early in the proceedings. The headline sought was a global electrification target: 35% of global final energy consumption will come from electricity by 2035, in the hope that this would reduce direct fossil fuel emissions. Ultimately, the cover text failed to pass muster because the European Union objected to the text’s lack of any explicit mention of ‘fossil fuel,’ let alone its phase-out. The COP process is arduously protracted as even a single country’s objection can stall progress. Country-blocks outside the EU, such as coalitions of the least developed countries, island nations, some South American countries — reportedly 130 countries — were also insistent on fossil fuel language. While COP 31 made some progress on old pathways, such as the Just Transition agreement, it is perplexing that the delegations could not make progress on the other big prong of negotiations: climate finance. The increase in solar panel installations and the significant shift towards battery use in grid storage and transport did not come cheap: the cost of the land required for their installation, their intermittent nature of being dependent on weather, grid upgrades all carry costs. It is global markets, imperfectly connected, but connected, that have managed to bring it to this stage over decades. India and China, major fossil emitters, with large, still indigent populations, are also leaders in total clean energy installations. Therefore it stands to reason that developed countries, which have committed to providing climate finance in recognition of their historical emissions, make good on past promises to shoulder the cost of the carbon emissions that are responsible for warming. Economic crises are a feature, and not a bug, of the interconnected financial system enveloping the world and there are, undeniably, challenges to diverting the necessary finance towards countries most vulnerable to climate change impact. However, it is no longer prudent to sweep this under the rug by scuttling experimental approaches — namely carbon capture — as inimical to the broader commitment to eschew fossil fuel. When the primary framework climate agreement was crafted three decades ago, nobody envisaged AI and the drain that data centres portended or the wars that would see the vociferous antagonists of coal immediately shore up their gas reserves. Without honest good-faith dialogue, the COP is at risk of being a sideshow: a mortal blow to multilateralism.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: climate change / Turkey / politics / Australia / electricity production and distribution / energy and resource / European Union / solar / India / China / carbon emissions / population / economy / carbon capture and sequestration / Artificial Intelligence / data management storage

📚 TOP 4 HARD VOCABULARY WORDS EXTRACTED FROM THIS PARAGRAPH (TAP CARD FOR PICTURE & SYNONYMS):
Multilateral (Adjective)
बहुपक्षीय — जिसमें दो से अधिक देश (जैसे UN, G20, BRICS) मिलकर साझा फैसला लेते हैं।
✓ Syn: Plurilateral, International, Coalition-based  |  ✖ Ant: Unilateral, One-sided, Isolated
Indigenous (Adjective)
स्वदेशी — अपने ही देश (भारत) के वैज्ञानिकों और इंजीनियरों द्वारा देश में विकसित किया गया।
✓ Syn: Domestic, Home-grown, Native  |  ✖ Ant: Imported, Foreign, Exotic
Electrification (Noun)
महत्वपूर्ण विश्लेषणात्मक शब्द — इस लेख में 'Electrification' मुख्य प्रभाव और नीतिगत स्थिति को स्पष्ट करता है।
✓ Syn: Significant, Substantial, Strategic  |  ✖ Ant: Insignificant, Negligible, Trivial
Sequestration (Noun)
महत्वपूर्ण विश्लेषणात्मक शब्द — इस लेख में 'Sequestration' मुख्य प्रभाव और नीतिगत स्थिति को स्पष्ट करता है।
✓ Syn: Significant, Substantial, Strategic  |  ✖ Ant: Insignificant, Negligible, Trivial
🧠 2 ANALYTICAL EXAM QUESTIONS BASED ON THIS EDITORIAL:
Q1. Based on a critical reading of the above ✍️ Editorial & Opinion passage on "Fatal disagreement: on the COP31 summit", which of the following statements accurately reflects the central analytical observation of the text?
A. Developed nations must bear much of the cost of carbon emissions.
B. Contrary to the passage, the issue of 'Fatal disagreement: on the COP31 summit' requires zero institutional or regulatory intervention at any level.
C. The passage argues that all empirical data and statutory mechanisms related to 'Fatal disagreement: on the COP31 summit' should be permanently discontinued.
D. The author contends that 'Fatal disagreement: on the COP31 summit' has no bearing on public governance, economy, or citizen welfare.
✅ Correct Answer: Option (A) — Sahi Jawab Option (A) hai. Is passage ki mukhya line saaf batati hai: "Developed nations must bear much of the cost of carbon emissions." (Hinglish Arth: विकसित देशों को कार्बन उत्सर्जन की अधिकांश लागत वहन करनी होगी)
Q2. Which of the following key analytical points or conclusions is explicitly highlighted by the author in the passage regarding "Fatal disagreement: on the COP31 summit"?

B. climate change / Turkey / politics / Australia / electricity production and distribution / energy and resource / European Union / solar / India /...
C. Dismissing constitutional accountability and relying solely on unverified short-term measures.
D. Recommending the immediate suspension of all regulatory and scientific assessments mentioned in the text.
✅ Correct Answer: Option (B) — Sahi Jawab Option (B) hai. Lekhak ne passage ke vishleshan mein is baat par zor diya hai: "climate change / Turkey / politics / Australia / electricity production and distribution / energy and resource / European Union / solar / India /..." (Hinglish Arth: जलवायु परिवर्तन / तुर्की / राजनीति / ऑस्ट्रेलिया / बिजली उत्पादन और वितरण / ऊर्जा और संसाधन / यूरोपीय संघ / सौर / भारत / चीन / कार्बन उत्सर्जन / जनसंख्या / अर्थव्यवस्था / कार्बन कैप्चर और अनुक्रम)

Ultimately, the cover text failed to pass muster because the European Union objected to the text’s lack of any explicit mention of ‘fossil fuel,’ let alone its phase-out. Country-blocks outside the EU, such as coalitions of the least developed countries, island nations, some South American countries — reportedly 130 countries — were also insistent on fossil fuel language. While COP 31 made some progress on old pathways, such as the Just Transition agreement, it is perplexing that the delegations could not make progress on the other big prong of negotiations: climate finance. The increase in solar panel installations and the significant shift towards battery use in grid storage and transport did not come cheap: the cost of the land required for their installation, their intermittent nature of being dependent on weather, grid upgrades all carry costs. It is global markets, imperfectly connected, but connected, that have managed to bring it to this stage over decades. India and China, major fossil emitters, with large, still indigent populations, are also leaders in total clean energy installations. Therefore it stands to reason that developed countries, which have committed to providing climate finance in recognition of their historical emissions, make good on past promises to shoulder the cost of the carbon emissions that are responsible for warming. Economic crises are a feature, and not a bug, of the interconnected financial system enveloping the world and there are, undeniably, challenges to diverting the necessary finance towards countries most vulnerable to climate change impact. However, it is no longer prudent to sweep this under the rug by scuttling experimental approaches — namely carbon capture — as inimical to the broader commitment to eschew fossil fuel. When the primary framework climate agreement was crafted three decades ago, nobody envisaged AI and the drain that data centres portended or the wars that would see the vociferous antagonists of coal immediately shore up their gas reserves. Without honest good-faith dialogue, the COP is at risk of being a sideshow: a mortal blow to multilateralism.

articles.title: Just verdict: on Myanmar and the International Court of Justice
articles.examRelevance: UPSC, State PSC, SSC & Banking Mains: Deep Analytical Core Summary, Policy Critique, 4 Hinglish Vocab & 2 Analytical Questions
fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: Rohingya cannot return unless Myanmar turns democratic

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: On November 19, the International Court of Justice held that Myanmar committed genocide against the Rohingya. It is for the first time that the court has found any state responsible for the crime. The verdict, with nine votes to six, was not lightly reached. Genocide requires proof of an intent to destroy a group. In the absence of direct evidence of a plan, the court could infer that intent only if it was “the only reasonable inference” from the facts, a high bar to affix responsibility. The facts it accepted are harrowing. In 2017, in what Myanmar’s army called “clearance operations” against the insurgent Arakan Rohingya Salvation Army, at least 10,000 Rohingya were killed, 1,834 raped and 392 villages destroyed in northern Rakhine State. Over 7,00,000 fled to Bangladesh. Then Army chief Min Aung Hlaing, now Myanmar’s “civilian” President, called the “Bengali problem” an “unfinished job”. Myanmar argued that it had only been fighting insurgents or at worst, driving the Rohingya out or punishing them. The court said that the army drew no distinction between fighters and civilians, had no plan to move anyone, fired on fleeing people and killed children on a scale that could not be explained as punishment. Seen alongside decades of discrimination, the evidence pointed to an intent to destroy. The incidents of 2017 were no aberration. The army drove lakhs of Rohingya into Bangladesh in 1978 and 1991-92. The junta stripped the Rohingya of citizenship in 1982 and the state branded them as “foreigners” in Arakan, disenfranchising them in 2015. While the junta’s Bamar-Buddhist vision has oppressed every minority, the Rohingya have been subjected to the most brutality. More than 1.2 million are in Bangladesh, living in dilapidated conditions, made worse due to diminished international aid. The court ordered Myanmar to allow their safe, voluntary and dignified return and to compensate them, but it has no means of enforcing its judgment. Only the UN Security Council can, but it will be subject to vetoes by Myanmar’s backers, China and Russia. On the very day of the verdict, the two joined the U.S. in Shenzhen to declare the “immunities of State officials” of “paramount importance”. Others, India among them, have courted the regime in Naypyitaw regardless, following sham elections that made the junta leader civilian President earlier this year. And Rakhine State, mired in civil war, is now mostly held by the Arakan Army which is accused of atrocities against the Rohingya. Only a truly democratic, federal, plural and peaceful Myanmar can bring the Rohingya home in safety.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: international court or tribunal / Myanmar / Rohingya crisis / crime / armed Forces / sexual assault / Bangladesh / Citizenship / welfare / United Nations / China / Russia / India / democracy

hinglishTracks.en: Rohingya cannot return unless Myanmar turns democratic
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: देखिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का सीधा सा मतलब समझिये — जब तक म्यांमार लोकतांत्रिक नहीं हो जाता, रोहिंग्या वापस नहीं लौट सकते।

hinglishTracks.en: On November 19, the International Court of Justice held that Myanmar committed genocide against the Rohingya.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: ज़रा ध्यान दीजियेगा, यहाँ मुख्य बात यह है कि — 19 नवंबर को, अंतर्राष्ट्रीय न्यायालय ने माना कि म्यांमार ने रोहिंग्या के खिलाफ नरसंहार किया है।। नोट कर लीजिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का वर्ड 'International' एग्जाम के लिए बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है! इसका अर्थ है: महत्वपूर्ण विश्लेषणात्मक शब्द — इस लेख में 'International' मुख्य प्रभाव और नीतिगत स्थिति को स्पष्ट करता है। इसके Synonyms हैं: Comprehensive, Influential, Decisive और Antonyms हैं: Superficial, Ineffective, Fragile।

hinglishTracks.en: It is for the first time that the court has found any state responsible for the crime.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: आसान हिंग्लिश भाषा में इसे समझें तो — यह पहली बार है कि अदालत ने किसी राज्य को अपराध के लिए जिम्मेदार पाया है।। नोट कर लीजिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का वर्ड 'Responsibility' एग्जाम के लिए बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है! इसका अर्थ है: महत्वपूर्ण विश्लेषणात्मक शब्द — इस लेख में 'Responsibility' मुख्य प्रभाव और नीतिगत स्थिति को स्पष्ट करता है। इसके Synonyms हैं: Significant, Substantial, Strategic और Antonyms हैं: Insignificant, Negligible, Trivial।

hinglishTracks.en: The verdict, with nine votes to six, was not lightly reached.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: देखिये, एग्जाम के नज़रिये से यह पॉइंट बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है — छह के मुक़ाबले नौ वोटों से आया फ़ैसला हल्के में नहीं लिया गया।।

hinglishTracks.en: Genocide requires proof of an intent to destroy a group.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: चलिए, अब इस अगली लाइन का असली मतलब देखते हैं — नरसंहार के लिए किसी समूह को नष्ट करने के इरादे के सबूत की आवश्यकता होती है।।

hinglishTracks.en: In the absence of direct evidence of a plan, the court could infer that intent only if it was “the only reasonable inference” from the facts, a high bar to affix responsibility.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: देखिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का सीधा सा मतलब समझिये — किसी योजना के प्रत्यक्ष साक्ष्य के अभाव में, अदालत उस इरादे का अनुमान तभी लगा सकती है जब यह तथ्यों से "एकमात्र उचित निष्कर्ष" हो, जो जिम्मेदारी तय करने के लिए एक उच्च बाधा है।। नोट कर लीजिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का वर्ड 'Responsibility' एग्जाम के लिए बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है! इसका अर्थ है: महत्वपूर्ण विश्लेषणात्मक शब्द — इस लेख में 'Responsibility' मुख्य प्रभाव और नीतिगत स्थिति को स्पष्ट करता है। इसके Synonyms हैं: Significant, Substantial, Strategic और Antonyms हैं: Insignificant, Negligible, Trivial।

hinglishTracks.en: The facts it accepted are harrowing.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: ज़रा ध्यान दीजियेगा, यहाँ मुख्य बात यह है कि — इसमें जो तथ्य स्वीकार किये गये वे कष्टदायक हैं।।

hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: आसान हिंग्लिश भाषा में इसे समझें तो — 2017 में, जिसे म्यांमार की सेना ने विद्रोही अराकान रोहिंग्या साल्वेशन आर्मी के खिलाफ "क्लीयरेंस ऑपरेशन" कहा था, उत्तरी रखाइन राज्य में कम से कम 10,000 रोहिंग्या मारे गए, 1,834 बलात्कार हुए और 392 गांव नष्ट हो गए।।

hinglishTracks.en: Then Army chief Min Aung Hlaing, now Myanmar’s “civilian” President, called the “Bengali problem” an “unfinished job”.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: चलिए, अब इस अगली लाइन का असली मतलब देखते हैं — तत्कालीन सेना प्रमुख मिन आंग ह्लाइंग, जो अब म्यांमार के "नागरिक" राष्ट्रपति हैं, ने "बंगाली समस्या" को "अधूरा काम" कहा।।

hinglishTracks.en: Myanmar argued that it had only been fighting insurgents or at worst, driving the Rohingya out or punishing them.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: देखिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का सीधा सा मतलब समझिये — म्यांमार ने तर्क दिया कि वह केवल विद्रोहियों से लड़ रहा है या सबसे खराब स्थिति में, रोहिंग्या को बाहर निकाल रहा है या उन्हें दंडित कर रहा है।।

hinglishTracks.en: The court said that the army drew no distinction between fighters and civilians, had no plan to move anyone, fired on fleeing people and killed children on a scale that could not be explained as punishment.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: ज़रा ध्यान दीजियेगा, यहाँ मुख्य बात यह है कि — अदालत ने कहा कि सेना ने लड़ाकों और नागरिकों के बीच कोई अंतर नहीं किया, किसी को स्थानांतरित करने की कोई योजना नहीं थी, भाग रहे लोगों पर गोलीबारी की और बच्चों को इतने बड़े पैमाने पर मार डाला कि सजा के रूप में व्याख्या नहीं की जा सकती।।

hinglishTracks.en: Seen alongside decades of discrimination, the evidence pointed to an intent to destroy.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: आसान हिंग्लिश भाषा में इसे समझें तो — दशकों के भेदभाव के साथ देखा गया, सबूत नष्ट करने के इरादे की ओर इशारा करते हैं।। नोट कर लीजिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का वर्ड 'Discrimination' एग्जाम के लिए बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है! इसका अर्थ है: महत्वपूर्ण विश्लेषणात्मक शब्द — इस लेख में 'Discrimination' मुख्य प्रभाव और नीतिगत स्थिति को स्पष्ट करता है। इसके Synonyms हैं: Restrictive, Counteractive, Adverse और Antonyms हैं: Constructive, Supportive, Favorable।

hinglishTracks.en: The incidents of 2017 were no aberration.

hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: देखिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का सीधा सा मतलब समझिये — जुंटा ने 1982 में रोहिंग्या की नागरिकता छीन ली और राज्य ने उन्हें अराकान में "विदेशी" करार दिया और 2015 में उन्हें मताधिकार से वंचित कर दिया।।

✍️ Editorial & Opinion Paragraph #2 of 30 (24 NOV)

📰 Just verdict: on Myanmar and the International Court of Justice

📌 Published: 24 Nov 2026, 12:04:37 PM
🎙️ Desi Hinglish Voice Educator • 🚂 Live Train Line Highlight & Screen Lock

1. Core Context & Background: Rohingya cannot return unless Myanmar turns democratic

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: On November 19, the International Court of Justice held that Myanmar committed genocide against the Rohingya. It is for the first time that the court has found any state responsible for the crime. The verdict, with nine votes to six, was not lightly reached. Genocide requires proof of an intent to destroy a group. In the absence of direct evidence of a plan, the court could infer that intent only if it was “the only reasonable inference” from the facts, a high bar to affix responsibility. The facts it accepted are harrowing. In 2017, in what Myanmar’s army called “clearance operations” against the insurgent Arakan Rohingya Salvation Army, at least 10,000 Rohingya were killed, 1,834 raped and 392 villages destroyed in northern Rakhine State. Over 7,00,000 fled to Bangladesh. Then Army chief Min Aung Hlaing, now Myanmar’s “civilian” President, called the “Bengali problem” an “unfinished job”. Myanmar argued that it had only been fighting insurgents or at worst, driving the Rohingya out or punishing them. The court said that the army drew no distinction between fighters and civilians, had no plan to move anyone, fired on fleeing people and killed children on a scale that could not be explained as punishment. Seen alongside decades of discrimination, the evidence pointed to an intent to destroy. The incidents of 2017 were no aberration. The army drove lakhs of Rohingya into Bangladesh in 1978 and 1991-92. The junta stripped the Rohingya of citizenship in 1982 and the state branded them as “foreigners” in Arakan, disenfranchising them in 2015. While the junta’s Bamar-Buddhist vision has oppressed every minority, the Rohingya have been subjected to the most brutality. More than 1.2 million are in Bangladesh, living in dilapidated conditions, made worse due to diminished international aid. The court ordered Myanmar to allow their safe, voluntary and dignified return and to compensate them, but it has no means of enforcing its judgment. Only the UN Security Council can, but it will be subject to vetoes by Myanmar’s backers, China and Russia. On the very day of the verdict, the two joined the U.S. in Shenzhen to declare the “immunities of State officials” of “paramount importance”. Others, India among them, have courted the regime in Naypyitaw regardless, following sham elections that made the junta leader civilian President earlier this year. And Rakhine State, mired in civil war, is now mostly held by the Arakan Army which is accused of atrocities against the Rohingya. Only a truly democratic, federal, plural and peaceful Myanmar can bring the Rohingya home in safety.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: international court or tribunal / Myanmar / Rohingya crisis / crime / armed Forces / sexual assault / Bangladesh / Citizenship / welfare / United Nations / China / Russia / India / democracy

fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: India can no longer afford its silence on the multi-trillion dollar AI arms race

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: The Initial Public Offering (IPO) of Anthropic , PBC is a mile marker in the arms race to develop superintelligent systems driven by generative AI . Traders valued the firm at $1.27 trillion, a denomination that is bound to become more and more familiar in an industry backed by an endless appetite for capital and unprecedented forms of financialisation. Anthropic’s statements emphasise warnings on the safety of its systems and the consequences of unbridled development of advanced systems. In the history of the development of this technology, this PR spin may just be a blip. After all, their testing has led to AI agents that have broken out of sandboxes and infected unsuspecting organisations’ internal systems: a deluge of agentic chaos that is already a reality has led to little signs of the firm backing its words with action. A familiar trend is playing out, with open source LLMs showing frontier capabilities that can back their erratic impulses, appearing in the space of just months, or sometimes weeks. Advocates of pacing the frontier and managing these emerging risks have been marginalised in a way that has little precedent in this century. It is time for governments to get involved, and specifically, for India to raise its voice on these risks, loudly and unequivocally.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: While India’s AI industry is nascent, its positions on international forums carry the weight of a sixth of humanity. A mix of cynical calculations and practical considerations have blunted the use of that voice, for example in the U.S.’s hugely destabilising war of choice against Iran, and Israel’s ongoing genocide in Gaza. In taking a strong position on what could be the defining transformation of this decade, India has little to lose, and a lot to contribute. India’s AI policies are geared towards diffusion and research of helpful capabilities that can trickle down to the common citizen. The capabilities that the Union government and State governments seek to boost by leveraging AI are removed from the frontier research wreaking havoc within the information security profession around the world. Out-of-control AI agents promise, moreover, significant disruption to outdated government and private systems online. While India has little commercial leverage to curb San Francisco’s accelerationism, its voice is sure to be noticed. India’s focus on AI in international fora, such as the AI Impact Summit in Delhi, has been on consensus. This approach must change. India cannot be silent amid a U.S.-China technological race which could lead to catastrophic damage. New Delhi must not allow the U.S. to stop it from pushing for AI safety.

ultraAnalyticalQuestions2.question: Which of the following key analytical points or conclusions is explicitly highlighted by the author in the passage regarding "Going public on AI: On Anthropic IPO"?
options: Advocating complete policy paralysis and ignoring ground-level implementation challenges.
to stop it from pushing for AI safety.
Dismissing constitutional accountability and relying solely on unverified short-term measures.
Recommending the immediate suspension of all regulatory and scientific assessments mentioned in the text.
ultraAnalyticalQuestions2.answerText: to stop it from pushing for AI safety.
ultraAnalyticalQuestions2.hinglishExplanation: Sahi Jawab Option (B) hai. Lekhak ne passage ke vishleshan mein is baat par zor diya hai: "to stop it from pushing for AI safety." (Hinglish Arth: इसे एआई सुरक्षा पर जोर देने से रोकने के लिए।)

hinglishTracks.en: India can no longer afford its silence on the multi-trillion dollar AI arms race
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: देखिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का सीधा सा मतलब समझिये — भारत अब खरबों डॉलर की एआई हथियारों की होड़ पर अपनी चुप्पी बर्दाश्त नहीं कर सकता।

hinglishTracks.en: The Initial Public Offering (IPO) of Anthropic , PBC is a mile marker in the arms race to develop superintelligent systems driven by generative AI .
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: ज़रा ध्यान दीजियेगा, यहाँ मुख्य बात यह है कि — एंथ्रोपिक, पीबीसी की आरंभिक सार्वजनिक पेशकश (आईपीओ) जेनरेटिव एआई द्वारा संचालित सुपरइंटेलिजेंट सिस्टम विकसित करने के लिए हथियारों की दौड़ में एक मील का पत्थर है।।

hinglishTracks.en: Traders valued the firm at $1.27 trillion, a denomination that is bound to become more and more familiar in an industry backed by an endless appetite for capital and unprecedented forms of financialisation.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: आसान हिंग्लिश भाषा में इसे समझें तो — व्यापारियों ने कंपनी का मूल्य 1.27 ट्रिलियन डॉलर आंका, एक ऐसा मूल्य जो पूंजी की अंतहीन भूख और वित्तीयकरण के अभूतपूर्व रूपों द्वारा समर्थित उद्योग में अधिक से अधिक परिचित होना तय है।। नोट कर लीजिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का वर्ड 'Financialisation' एग्जाम के लिए बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है! इसका अर्थ है: वित्तीयकरण — इस अनुच्छेद में 'Financialisation' का प्रयोग एक महत्वपूर्ण प्रशासनिक और विश्लेषणात्मक अर्थ में किया गया है। इसके Synonyms हैं: Significant, Substantial, Strategic और Antonyms हैं: Insignificant, Negligible, Trivial।

hinglishTracks.en: Anthropic’s statements emphasise warnings on the safety of its systems and the consequences of unbridled development of advanced systems.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: देखिये, एग्जाम के नज़रिये से यह पॉइंट बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है — एंथ्रोपिक के बयान उसके सिस्टम की सुरक्षा और उन्नत सिस्टम के बेलगाम विकास के परिणामों पर चेतावनियों पर जोर देते हैं।।

hinglishTracks.en: In the history of the development of this technology, this PR spin may just be a blip.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: चलिए, अब इस अगली लाइन का असली मतलब देखते हैं — इस तकनीक के विकास के इतिहास में, यह पीआर स्पिन बस एक झटका हो सकता है।। नोट कर लीजिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का वर्ड 'Technological' एग्जाम के लिए बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है! इसका अर्थ है: महत्वपूर्ण विश्लेषणात्मक शब्द — इस लेख में 'Technological' मुख्य प्रभाव और नीतिगत स्थिति को स्पष्ट करता है। इसके Synonyms हैं: Comprehensive, Influential, Decisive और Antonyms हैं: Superficial, Ineffective, Fragile।

hinglishTracks.en: After all, their testing has led to AI agents that have broken out of sandboxes and infected unsuspecting organisations’ internal systems: a deluge of agentic chaos that is already a reality has led to little signs of the firm backing its words with action.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: देखिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का सीधा सा मतलब समझिये — आख़िरकार, उनके परीक्षण ने एआई एजेंटों को जन्म दिया है जो सैंडबॉक्स से बाहर निकल गए हैं और बिना सोचे-समझे संगठनों के आंतरिक सिस्टम को संक्रमित कर दिया है: एजेंटिक अराजकता की बाढ़ जो पहले से ही एक वास्तविकता है, ने फर्म के अपने शब्दों को कार्रवाई के साथ समर्थन करने के बहुत कम संकेत दिए हैं।। नोट कर लीजिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का वर्ड 'International' एग्जाम के लिए बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है! इसका अर्थ है: महत्वपूर्ण विश्लेषणात्मक शब्द — इस लेख में 'International' मुख्य प्रभाव और नीतिगत स्थिति को स्पष्ट करता है। इसके Synonyms हैं: Comprehensive, Influential, Decisive और Antonyms हैं: Superficial, Ineffective, Fragile।

hinglishTracks.en: A familiar trend is playing out, with open source LLMs showing frontier capabilities that can back their erratic impulses, appearing in the space of just months, or sometimes weeks.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: ज़रा ध्यान दीजियेगा, यहाँ मुख्य बात यह है कि — एक परिचित प्रवृत्ति चल रही है, जिसमें ओपन सोर्स एलएलएम अग्रणी क्षमताएं दिखा रहे हैं जो उनके अनियमित आवेगों को वापस कर सकते हैं, जो कुछ महीनों या कभी-कभी हफ्तों के अंतराल में दिखाई देते हैं।।

hinglishTracks.en: Advocates of pacing the frontier and managing these emerging risks have been marginalised in a way that has little precedent in this century.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: आसान हिंग्लिश भाषा में इसे समझें तो — सीमा पर तेजी से आगे बढ़ने और इन उभरते जोखिमों के प्रबंधन की वकालत करने वालों को इस तरह से हाशिए पर डाल दिया गया है, जिसकी इस सदी में बहुत कम मिसाल है।।

hinglishTracks.en: It is time for governments to get involved, and specifically, for India to raise its voice on these risks, loudly and unequivocally.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: देखिये, एग्जाम के नज़रिये से यह पॉइंट बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है — अब समय आ गया है कि सरकारें इसमें शामिल हों और विशेष रूप से भारत इन जोखिमों पर जोर-शोर से और स्पष्ट रूप से अपनी आवाज उठाए।।

hinglishTracks.en: While India’s AI industry is nascent, its positions on international forums carry the weight of a sixth of humanity.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: चलिए, अब इस अगली लाइन का असली मतलब देखते हैं — जबकि भारत का एआई उद्योग नवजात है, अंतरराष्ट्रीय मंचों पर इसकी स्थिति मानवता के छठे हिस्से का भार रखती है।। नोट कर लीजिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का वर्ड 'International' एग्जाम के लिए बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है! इसका अर्थ है: महत्वपूर्ण विश्लेषणात्मक शब्द — इस लेख में 'International' मुख्य प्रभाव और नीतिगत स्थिति को स्पष्ट करता है। इसके Synonyms हैं: Comprehensive, Influential, Decisive और Antonyms हैं: Superficial, Ineffective, Fragile।

hinglishTracks.en: A mix of cynical calculations and practical considerations have blunted the use of that voice, for example in the U.S.’s hugely destabilising war of choice against Iran, and Israel’s ongoing genocide in Gaza.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: देखिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का सीधा सा मतलब समझिये — सनकी गणनाओं और व्यावहारिक विचारों के मिश्रण ने उस आवाज के उपयोग को कुंद कर दिया है, उदाहरण के लिए ईरान के खिलाफ अमेरिका के बेहद अस्थिर करने वाले युद्ध और गाजा में इजरायल के चल रहे नरसंहार में।।

hinglishTracks.en: In taking a strong position on what could be the defining transformation of this decade, India has little to lose, and a lot to contribute.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: ज़रा ध्यान दीजियेगा, यहाँ मुख्य बात यह है कि — इस दशक का निर्णायक परिवर्तन क्या हो सकता है, इस पर मजबूत रुख अपनाने में भारत के पास खोने के लिए बहुत कुछ नहीं है, और योगदान करने के लिए बहुत कुछ है।। नोट कर लीजिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का वर्ड 'Transformation' एग्जाम के लिए बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है! इसका अर्थ है: परिवर्तन — इस अनुच्छेद में 'Transformation' का प्रयोग एक महत्वपूर्ण प्रशासनिक और विश्लेषणात्मक अर्थ में किया गया है। इसके Synonyms हैं: Significant, Substantial, Strategic और Antonyms हैं: Insignificant, Negligible, Trivial।

hinglishTracks.en: India’s AI policies are geared towards diffusion and research of helpful capabilities that can trickle down to the common citizen.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: आसान हिंग्लिश भाषा में इसे समझें तो — भारत की एआई नीतियां सहायक क्षमताओं के प्रसार और अनुसंधान के लिए तैयार हैं जो आम नागरिक तक पहुंच सकती हैं।।

hinglishTracks.en: The capabilities that the Union government and State governments seek to boost by leveraging AI are removed from the frontier research wreaking havoc within the information security profession around the world.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: देखिये, एग्जाम के नज़रिये से यह पॉइंट बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है — केंद्र सरकार और राज्य सरकारें एआई का लाभ उठाकर जिन क्षमताओं को बढ़ावा देना चाहती हैं, उन्हें दुनिया भर में सूचना सुरक्षा पेशे में कहर बरपा रहे सीमांत अनुसंधान से हटा दिया गया है।।

hinglishTracks.en: Out-of-control AI agents promise, moreover, significant disruption to outdated government and private systems online.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: चलिए, अब इस अगली लाइन का असली मतलब देखते हैं — इसके अलावा, नियंत्रण से बाहर एआई एजेंट ऑनलाइन पुरानी सरकारी और निजी प्रणालियों में महत्वपूर्ण व्यवधान का वादा करते हैं।।

hinglishTracks.en: While India has little commercial leverage to curb San Francisco’s accelerationism, its voice is sure to be noticed.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: देखिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का सीधा सा मतलब समझिये — हालाँकि सैन फ्रांसिस्को की तेजी को रोकने के लिए भारत के पास बहुत कम व्यावसायिक क्षमता है, लेकिन इसकी आवाज पर ध्यान दिया जाना निश्चित है।।

hinglishTracks.en: India’s focus on AI in international fora, such as the AI Impact Summit in Delhi, has been on consensus.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: ज़रा ध्यान दीजियेगा, यहाँ मुख्य बात यह है कि — दिल्ली में एआई इम्पैक्ट समिट जैसे अंतरराष्ट्रीय मंचों पर एआई पर भारत का ध्यान आम सहमति पर रहा है।। नोट कर लीजिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का वर्ड 'International' एग्जाम के लिए बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है! इसका अर्थ है: महत्वपूर्ण विश्लेषणात्मक शब्द — इस लेख में 'International' मुख्य प्रभाव और नीतिगत स्थिति को स्पष्ट करता है। इसके Synonyms हैं: Comprehensive, Influential, Decisive और Antonyms हैं: Superficial, Ineffective, Fragile।

hinglishTracks.en: This approach must change.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: आसान हिंग्लिश भाषा में इसे समझें तो — यह दृष्टिकोण बदलना होगा.।

hinglishTracks.en: India cannot be silent amid a U.S.-China technological race which could lead to catastrophic damage.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: देखिये, एग्जाम के नज़रिये से यह पॉइंट बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है — अमेरिका-चीन तकनीकी दौड़ के बीच भारत चुप नहीं रह सकता, जिससे विनाशकारी क्षति हो सकती है।। नोट कर लीजिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का वर्ड 'Technological' एग्जाम के लिए बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है! इसका अर्थ है: महत्वपूर्ण विश्लेषणात्मक शब्द — इस लेख में 'Technological' मुख्य प्रभाव और नीतिगत स्थिति को स्पष्ट करता है। इसके Synonyms हैं: Comprehensive, Influential, Decisive और Antonyms हैं: Superficial, Ineffective, Fragile।

hinglishTracks.en: New Delhi must not allow the U.S.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: चलिए, अब इस अगली लाइन का असली मतलब देखते हैं — नई दिल्ली को अमेरिका को अनुमति नहीं देनी चाहिए।

hinglishTracks.en: to stop it from pushing for AI safety.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: देखिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का सीधा सा मतलब समझिये — इसे एआई सुरक्षा पर जोर देने से रोकने के लिए।।

✍️ Editorial & Opinion Paragraph #5 of 30 (24 NOV)

📰 Going public on AI: On Anthropic IPO

📌 Published: 24 Nov 2026, 05:27:31 PM IST
🎙️ Desi Hinglish Voice Educator • 🚂 Live Train Line Highlight & Screen Lock

1. Core Context & Background: India can no longer afford its silence on the multi-trillion dollar AI arms race

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: The Initial Public Offering (IPO) of Anthropic , PBC is a mile marker in the arms race to develop superintelligent systems driven by generative AI . Traders valued the firm at $1.27 trillion, a denomination that is bound to become more and more familiar in an industry backed by an endless appetite for capital and unprecedented forms of financialisation. Anthropic’s statements emphasise warnings on the safety of its systems and the consequences of unbridled development of advanced systems. In the history of the development of this technology, this PR spin may just be a blip. After all, their testing has led to AI agents that have broken out of sandboxes and infected unsuspecting organisations’ internal systems: a deluge of agentic chaos that is already a reality has led to little signs of the firm backing its words with action. A familiar trend is playing out, with open source LLMs showing frontier capabilities that can back their erratic impulses, appearing in the space of just months, or sometimes weeks. Advocates of pacing the frontier and managing these emerging risks have been marginalised in a way that has little precedent in this century. It is time for governments to get involved, and specifically, for India to raise its voice on these risks, loudly and unequivocally.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: While India’s AI industry is nascent, its positions on international forums carry the weight of a sixth of humanity. A mix of cynical calculations and practical considerations have blunted the use of that voice, for example in the U.S.’s hugely destabilising war of choice against Iran, and Israel’s ongoing genocide in Gaza. In taking a strong position on what could be the defining transformation of this decade, India has little to lose, and a lot to contribute. India’s AI policies are geared towards diffusion and research of helpful capabilities that can trickle down to the common citizen. The capabilities that the Union government and State governments seek to boost by leveraging AI are removed from the frontier research wreaking havoc within the information security profession around the world. Out-of-control AI agents promise, moreover, significant disruption to outdated government and private systems online. While India has little commercial leverage to curb San Francisco’s accelerationism, its voice is sure to be noticed. India’s focus on AI in international fora, such as the AI Impact Summit in Delhi, has been on consensus. This approach must change. India cannot be silent amid a U.S.-China technological race which could lead to catastrophic damage. New Delhi must not allow the U.S. to stop it from pushing for AI safety.

Q1. Based on a critical reading of the above ✍️ Editorial & Opinion passage on "Going public on AI: On Anthropic IPO", which of the following statements accurately reflects the central analytical observation of the text?

✅ Correct Answer: Option (A) — Sahi Jawab Option (A) hai. Is passage ki mukhya line saaf batati hai: "India can no longer afford its silence on the multi-trillion dollar AI arms race." (Hinglish Arth: भारत अब खरबों डॉलर की एआई हथियारों की होड़ पर अपनी चुप्पी बर्दाश्त नहीं कर सकता)

articles.keyPoints:
• 1. Core Context & Background: India can no longer afford its silence on the multi-trillion dollar AI arms race
• 2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: The Initial Public Offering (IPO) of Anthropic , PBC is a mile marker in the arms race to develop superintelligent systems driven by generative AI . Traders valued the firm at $1.27 trillion, a denomination that is bound to become more and more familiar in an industry backed by an endless appetite for capital and unprecedented forms of financialisation. Anthropic’s statements emphasise warnings on the safety of its systems and the consequences of unbridled development of advanced systems. In the history of the development of this technology, this PR spin may just be a blip. After all, their testing has led to AI agents that have broken out of sandboxes and infected unsuspecting organisations’ internal systems: a deluge of agentic chaos that is already a reality has led to little signs of the firm backing its words with action. A familiar trend is playing out, with open source LLMs showing frontier capabilities that can back their erratic impulses, appearing in the space of just months, or sometimes weeks. Advocates of pacing the frontier and managing these emerging risks have been marginalised in a way that has little precedent in this century. It is time for governments to get involved, and specifically, for India to raise its voice on these risks, loudly and unequivocally.
• 3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: While India’s AI industry is nascent, its positions on international forums carry the weight of a sixth of humanity. A mix of cynical calculations and practical considerations have blunted the use of that voice, for example in the U.S.’s hugely destabilising war of choice against Iran, and Israel’s ongoing genocide in Gaza. In taking a strong position on what could be the defining transformation of this decade, India has little to lose, and a lot to contribute. India’s AI policies are geared towards diffusion and research of helpful capabilities that can trickle down to the common citizen. The capabilities that the Union government and State governments seek to boost by leveraging AI are removed from the frontier research wreaking havoc within the information security profession around the world. Out-of-control AI agents promise, moreover, significant disruption to outdated government and private systems online. While India has little commercial leverage to curb San Francisco’s accelerationism, its voice is sure to be noticed. India’s focus on AI in international fora, such as the AI Impact Summit in Delhi, has been on consensus. This approach must change. India cannot be silent amid a U.S.-China technological race which could lead to catastrophic damage. New Delhi must not allow the U.S. to stop it from pushing for AI safety.

fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: U.S., China, Russia must draw up a roadmap for talks on nuclear weapons

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: The first trilateral summit between the Presidents of China, the U.S. and Russia , held in Shenzhen on November 19, reflected both the changing global order and the leaders’ shared desire to remain engaged with one another in an increasingly unpredictable world. For U.S. President Donald Trump, the summit was a platform where he could push for joint talks between the world’s three largest nuclear powers on reducing nuclear warheads. After the New START treaty between the U.S. and Russia expired in February 2026, Moscow had signalled that it was ready for talks, but Mr. Trump wanted to involve China as well. For President Xi Jinping, the summit reinforced China’s position as a peer competitor to the U.S. While Russia seeks to deepen partnership with China, the U.S. is looking to build strategic stability. And for Russian President Vladimir Putin, whom the West sought to isolate after he launched the invasion of Ukraine, the summit offered a seat at the high table. The decision to start trilateral talks on nuclear arms and the joint declaration, which stated that ‘a nuclear war cannot be won and must never be fought’, are steps in the right direction. But much will depend on what follows.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: Many had compared the meet to the 1945 Yalta Conference, when Russian leader Joseph Stalin, U.S. President Franklin D. Roosevelt and British Prime Minister Winston Churchill met to discuss the future of post-War Europe. But Shenzhen was not a summit of the victors of a major war. This was more about three great powers setting terms of engagement in a changing world. The summit failed to achieve any breakthrough on any of the issues on the agenda — nuclear arms reduction, non-proliferation or the Ukraine war — or even offer a road map for the future. Moreover, it is not clear if the Shenzhen spirit could be sustained in the medium to long-term as another President in the U.S. could take a very different approach towards Russia and China. The three leaders have called for reform of the UN. While it is a welcome move, any attempt to reform the international system and institutions must also involve other powers, particularly rising middle powers such as India, South Africa and Brazil. But the Shenzhen framework could bring greater stability and predictability to great-power relations. This is important given that two of the Big Three are currently waging two separate wars. The leaders should draw up a clear road map for nuclear talks and other key issues outlined in the Shenzhen declaration, with realistic and achievable objectives. Otherwise, the summit would amount to little more than another diplomatic photo-op.

✍️ Editorial & Opinion Paragraph #6 of 30 (24 NOV)

📰 Three to tango: On Trump, Xi, Putin trilateral summit

📌 Published: 24 Nov 2026, 05:27:31 PM IST
🎙️ Desi Hinglish Voice Educator • 🚂 Live Train Line Highlight & Screen Lock

1. Core Context & Background: U.S., China, Russia must draw up a roadmap for talks on nuclear weapons

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: The first trilateral summit between the Presidents of China, the U.S. and Russia , held in Shenzhen on November 19, reflected both the changing global order and the leaders’ shared desire to remain engaged with one another in an increasingly unpredictable world. For U.S. President Donald Trump, the summit was a platform where he could push for joint talks between the world’s three largest nuclear powers on reducing nuclear warheads. After the New START treaty between the U.S. and Russia expired in February 2026, Moscow had signalled that it was ready for talks, but Mr. Trump wanted to involve China as well. For President Xi Jinping, the summit reinforced China’s position as a peer competitor to the U.S. While Russia seeks to deepen partnership with China, the U.S. is looking to build strategic stability. And for Russian President Vladimir Putin, whom the West sought to isolate after he launched the invasion of Ukraine, the summit offered a seat at the high table. The decision to start trilateral talks on nuclear arms and the joint declaration, which stated that ‘a nuclear war cannot be won and must never be fought’, are steps in the right direction. But much will depend on what follows.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: Many had compared the meet to the 1945 Yalta Conference, when Russian leader Joseph Stalin, U.S. President Franklin D. Roosevelt and British Prime Minister Winston Churchill met to discuss the future of post-War Europe. But Shenzhen was not a summit of the victors of a major war. This was more about three great powers setting terms of engagement in a changing world. The summit failed to achieve any breakthrough on any of the issues on the agenda — nuclear arms reduction, non-proliferation or the Ukraine war — or even offer a road map for the future. Moreover, it is not clear if the Shenzhen spirit could be sustained in the medium to long-term as another President in the U.S. could take a very different approach towards Russia and China. The three leaders have called for reform of the UN. While it is a welcome move, any attempt to reform the international system and institutions must also involve other powers, particularly rising middle powers such as India, South Africa and Brazil. But the Shenzhen framework could bring greater stability and predictability to great-power relations. This is important given that two of the Big Three are currently waging two separate wars. The leaders should draw up a clear road map for nuclear talks and other key issues outlined in the Shenzhen declaration, with realistic and achievable objectives. Otherwise, the summit would amount to little more than another diplomatic photo-op.

📚 TOP 4 HARD VOCABULARY WORDS EXTRACTED FROM THIS PARAGRAPH (TAP CARD FOR PICTURE & SYNONYMS):
Predictably (Adverb)
जैसा पहले से अनुमान था — बिना किसी आश्चर्य के बिल्कुल पूर्वानुमान के मुताबिक होना।
✓ Syn: Foreseeably, Expectedly, Inevitably  |  ✖ Ant: Unexpectedly, Surprisingly, Abruptly
Institutional (Adjective)
संस्थागत — देश की संवैधानिक या सरकारी संस्थाओं के नियमों और ढांचे से जुड़ा हुआ।
✓ Syn: Systemic, Organizational, Constitutional  |  ✖ Ant: Individual, Informal, Unorganized
Sustainability (Noun)
सतत विकास — पर्यावरण और भविष्य की पीढ़ियों को नुकसान पहुँचाए बिना लंबे समय तक चलने वाला विकास।
✓ Syn: Viability, Eco-balance, Durability  |  ✖ Ant: Depletion, Unsustainability, Destruction
Proliferation (Noun)
प्रसार — इस अनुच्छेद में 'Proliferation' का प्रयोग एक महत्वपूर्ण प्रशासनिक और विश्लेषणात्मक अर्थ में किया गया है।
✓ Syn: Significant, Substantial, Strategic  |  ✖ Ant: Insignificant, Negligible, Trivial
🧠 2 ANALYTICAL EXAM QUESTIONS BASED ON THIS EDITORIAL:
Q1. Based on a critical reading of the above ✍️ Editorial & Opinion passage on "Three to tango: On Trump, Xi, Putin trilateral summit", which of the following statements accurately reflects the central analytical observation of the text?
A. U.S., China, Russia must draw up a roadmap for talks on nuclear weapons.
B. Contrary to the passage, the issue of 'Three to tango: On Trump, Xi, Putin trilateral s' requires zero institutional or regulatory intervention at any level.
C. The passage argues that all empirical data and statutory mechanisms related to 'Three to tango: On Trump, Xi, Putin trilatera' should be permanently discontinued.
D. The author contends that 'Three to tango: On Trump, Xi, Putin trilatera' has no bearing on public governance, economy, or citizen welfare.
✅ Correct Answer: Option (A) — Sahi Jawab Option (A) hai. Is passage ki mukhya line saaf batati hai: "U.S., China, Russia must draw up a roadmap for talks on nuclear weapons." (Hinglish Arth: अमेरिका, चीन, रूस को परमाणु हथियारों पर बातचीत के लिए एक रोडमैप तैयार करना चाहिए)
Q2. Which of the following key analytical points or conclusions is explicitly highlighted by the author in the passage regarding "Three to tango: On Trump, Xi, Putin trilateral summit"?
A. Advocating complete policy paralysis and ignoring ground-level implementation challenges.
B. Otherwise, the summit would amount to little more than another diplomatic photo-op.
C. Dismissing constitutional accountability and relying solely on unverified short-term measures.
D. Recommending the immediate suspension of all regulatory and scientific assessments mentioned in the text.
✅ Correct Answer: Option (B) — Sahi Jawab Option (B) hai. Lekhak ne passage ke vishleshan mein is baat par zor diya hai: "Otherwise, the summit would amount to little more than another diplomatic photo-op." (Hinglish Arth: अन्यथा, शिखर सम्मेलन एक और राजनयिक फोटो-ऑप से थोड़ा अधिक होगा।)

articles.title: LoP Ritabrata Banerjee files counter complaint against Mamata-Trinamool for fabrication of signature on affidavits
articles.examRelevance: GS Paper-II & Polity: Constitutional Amendments, Supreme Court Judgements, Parliamentary Bills & Governance Schemes
fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: Both Trinamool factions raise allegations of signature forgery and document fabrication, file complaints against each other

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: Leader of Opposition in West Bengal Ritabrata Banerjee on Monday (November 23, 2026) filed a police complaint against Mamata-All India Trinamool Congress for fabricating signatures on affidavits to claim their stake in the party name and symbol. A day earlier, Mamata-Trinamool filed a complaint against Mr. Ritabrata Banerjee under similar allegations. The Democratic Trinamool Congress MLA, along with Opposition chief whip Akhruzamman and spokesperson Riju Dutta went to the Kalighat Police Station to file the complaint. “They have threatened many people to sign affidavits; they also manipulated a few MLAs to sign under false pretense. We have already filed complaints at various police stations. We will share them with the ECI,” Mr Ritabrata Banerjee said. He also added that people have been made to sign affidavits under false claims of filling up forms for various schemes, relief materials, and other things and that it was an attempt to “mislead” people. Since the regime change in West Bengal, the Trinamool Congress has bifurcated into two factions, with almost 65 of 80 Trinamool MLAs rallying behind Mr Ritabrata Banerjee and abandoning the Mamata Banerjee faction. As tensions rose, both factions exercised their claims over the party’s name and symbol. However, Election Commission of India (ECI) barred both from using the original “All India Trinamool Congress” name and the party symbol. Since the split, both factions have submitted an array of affidavits with the ECI in support of each of the faction’s claim over the symbol and party name. Mamata-Trinamool leader Subhasish Chakraborty had filed the official complaint dated November 20, against Mr Ritabrata Banerjee at the same Kalighat Police Station for falsification, forging signatures of unsuspecting citizens and creation and fabrication of affidavits which have allegedly been filed before the ECI. In the complaint filed by Mamata-Trinamool, they have also named Nanoor Police Station Officer-in-charge Sanjoy Sarkar, MLA Arup Roy, and several others as co-conspirators in the case. “The material and evidence presently in my possession disclose that an organised exercise has been undertaken through the machinery of Nanoor Police Station for the preparation of fake affidavits in support of the rival faction, including affidavits purporting to show that ordinary members of the public recognise Arup Roy as the leader of the AITC and do not accept Smt. Mamata Banerjee as its leader,” reads the copy of the police complaint. This comes after Mamata-AITC general secretary Abhishek Banerjee had earlier on November 5 claimed that he has video evidence of fabricated affidavits being filed out in favour of Mr. Ritabrata Banerjee.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: “He says one thing in the morning, another in the evening and something else at night. Answering his questions is a waste of time and energy. I don’t have that much time,” Mr. Ritabrata Banerjee said on Monday (November 23).

articles.newspaperPrintHtml:
🏛️ Political, National & Polity Paragraph #7 of 30 (24 NOV)

📰 LoP Ritabrata Banerjee files counter complaint against Mamata-Trinamool for fabrication of signature on affidavits

📌 Published: 24 Nov 2026, 02:52:16 AM
🎙️ Desi Hinglish Voice Educator • 🚂 Live Train Line Highlight & Screen Lock

1. Core Context & Background: Both Trinamool factions raise allegations of signature forgery and document fabrication, file complaints against each other

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: Leader of Opposition in West Bengal Ritabrata Banerjee on Monday (November 23, 2026) filed a police complaint against Mamata-All India Trinamool Congress for fabricating signatures on affidavits to claim their stake in the party name and symbol. A day earlier, Mamata-Trinamool filed a complaint against Mr. Ritabrata Banerjee under similar allegations. The Democratic Trinamool Congress MLA, along with Opposition chief whip Akhruzamman and spokesperson Riju Dutta went to the Kalighat Police Station to file the complaint. “They have threatened many people to sign affidavits; they also manipulated a few MLAs to sign under false pretense. We have already filed complaints at various police stations. We will share them with the ECI,” Mr Ritabrata Banerjee said. He also added that people have been made to sign affidavits under false claims of filling up forms for various schemes, relief materials, and other things and that it was an attempt to “mislead” people. Since the regime change in West Bengal, the Trinamool Congress has bifurcated into two factions, with almost 65 of 80 Trinamool MLAs rallying behind Mr Ritabrata Banerjee and abandoning the Mamata Banerjee faction. As tensions rose, both factions exercised their claims over the party’s name and symbol. However, Election Commission of India (ECI) barred both from using the original “All India Trinamool Congress” name and the party symbol. Since the split, both factions have submitted an array of affidavits with the ECI in support of each of the faction’s claim over the symbol and party name. Mamata-Trinamool leader Subhasish Chakraborty had filed the official complaint dated November 20, against Mr Ritabrata Banerjee at the same Kalighat Police Station for falsification, forging signatures of unsuspecting citizens and creation and fabrication of affidavits which have allegedly been filed before the ECI. In the complaint filed by Mamata-Trinamool, they have also named Nanoor Police Station Officer-in-charge Sanjoy Sarkar, MLA Arup Roy, and several others as co-conspirators in the case. “The material and evidence presently in my possession disclose that an organised exercise has been undertaken through the machinery of Nanoor Police Station for the preparation of fake affidavits in support of the rival faction, including affidavits purporting to show that ordinary members of the public recognise Arup Roy as the leader of the AITC and do not accept Smt. Mamata Banerjee as its leader,” reads the copy of the police complaint. This comes after Mamata-AITC general secretary Abhishek Banerjee had earlier on November 5 claimed that he has video evidence of fabricated affidavits being filed out in favour of Mr. Ritabrata Banerjee.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: “He says one thing in the morning, another in the evening and something else at night. Answering his questions is a waste of time and energy. I don’t have that much time,” Mr. Ritabrata Banerjee said on Monday (November 23).

articles.keyPoints:
• 1. Core Context & Background: Both Trinamool factions raise allegations of signature forgery and document fabrication, file complaints against each other
• 2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: Leader of Opposition in West Bengal Ritabrata Banerjee on Monday (November 23, 2026) filed a police complaint against Mamata-All India Trinamool Congress for fabricating signatures on affidavits to claim their stake in the party name and symbol. A day earlier, Mamata-Trinamool filed a complaint against Mr. Ritabrata Banerjee under similar allegations. The Democratic Trinamool Congress MLA, along with Opposition chief whip Akhruzamman and spokesperson Riju Dutta went to the Kalighat Police Station to file the complaint. “They have threatened many people to sign affidavits; they also manipulated a few MLAs to sign under false pretense. We have already filed complaints at various police stations. We will share them with the ECI,” Mr Ritabrata Banerjee said. He also added that people have been made to sign affidavits under false claims of filling up forms for various schemes, relief materials, and other things and that it was an attempt to “mislead” people. Since the regime change in West Bengal, the Trinamool Congress has bifurcated into two factions, with almost 65 of 80 Trinamool MLAs rallying behind Mr Ritabrata Banerjee and abandoning the Mamata Banerjee faction. As tensions rose, both factions exercised their claims over the party’s name and symbol. However, Election Commission of India (ECI) barred both from using the original “All India Trinamool Congress” name and the party symbol. Since the split, both factions have submitted an array of affidavits with the ECI in support of each of the faction’s claim over the symbol and party name. Mamata-Trinamool leader Subhasish Chakraborty had filed the official complaint dated November 20, against Mr Ritabrata Banerjee at the same Kalighat Police Station for falsification, forging signatures of unsuspecting citizens and creation and fabrication of affidavits which have allegedly been filed before the ECI. In the complaint filed by Mamata-Trinamool, they have also named Nanoor Police Station Officer-in-charge Sanjoy Sarkar, MLA Arup Roy, and several others as co-conspirators in the case. “The material and evidence presently in my possession disclose that an organised exercise has been undertaken through the machinery of Nanoor Police Station for the preparation of fake affidavits in support of the rival faction, including affidavits purporting to show that ordinary members of the public recognise Arup Roy as the leader of the AITC and do not accept Smt. Mamata Banerjee as its leader,” reads the copy of the police complaint. This comes after Mamata-AITC general secretary Abhishek Banerjee had earlier on November 5 claimed that he has video evidence of fabricated affidavits being filed out in favour of Mr. Ritabrata Banerjee.
• 3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: “He says one thing in the morning, another in the evening and something else at night. Answering his questions is a waste of time and energy. I don’t have that much time,” Mr. Ritabrata Banerjee said on Monday (November 23).

fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: ‘I don’t support this. In fact, our party does not approve such behaviour from our ranks. The party is inquiring into the matter and will follow up,’ said Manik Saha

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: Tripura Chief Minister Dr. Manik Saha on Monday (November 23, 2026) reacted to the presence of several masked youths in a BJP election rally in Agartala on Saturday (November 21). He said he had come to know this from newspaper reports and subsequently took up the matter with the party leadership. “I don’t support this. In fact, our party does not approve such behaviour from our ranks. The party is inquiring into the matter and will follow up,” he told reporters. Elections to 21 Urban Local Bodies including Agartala Municipal Corporation (AMC) are due on November 27. The ruling BJP has already won five of them unopposed as candidates from other parties and independents did not submit nomination papers. The appearance of several masked men at the BJP’s election rally in Agartala stirred controversy, with CPI(M) and Congress registering complaints to the state election commission. The Congress also lodged a complaint at the West Agartala Police Station. Secretary of the State Election Commission on Monday (November 23) said they received complaints about the issues and forwarded them to the police headquarters for necessary action. He said the commission would ensure free and peaceful elections. BJP sources said veteran minister and city campaign in-charge Ratan Lal Nath organised the procession. They said the masked youths were actually party supporters from Mohanpur, north of Agartala, home Assembly constituency of minister Nath. CPI(M) and Congress, however, claimed the masked men were actually anti-socials who were likely to be engaged in creating trouble and rig the elections. They also complained of the silence of the police in initiating action despite registering complaints.
3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: Tripura / Communist Party of India -Marxist / Indian National Congress / Bharatiya Janata Party

🏛️ Political, National & Polity Paragraph #8 of 30 (24 NOV)

📰 Manik Saha says party probing presence of masked men in BJP election rally

📌 Published: 24 Nov 2026, 02:44:23 AM
🎙️ Desi Hinglish Voice Educator • 🚂 Live Train Line Highlight & Screen Lock

1. Core Context & Background: ‘I don’t support this. In fact, our party does not approve such behaviour from our ranks. The party is inquiring into the matter and will follow up,’ said Manik Saha

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: Tripura Chief Minister Dr. Manik Saha on Monday (November 23, 2026) reacted to the presence of several masked youths in a BJP election rally in Agartala on Saturday (November 21). He said he had come to know this from newspaper reports and subsequently took up the matter with the party leadership. “I don’t support this. In fact, our party does not approve such behaviour from our ranks. The party is inquiring into the matter and will follow up,” he told reporters. Elections to 21 Urban Local Bodies including Agartala Municipal Corporation (AMC) are due on November 27. The ruling BJP has already won five of them unopposed as candidates from other parties and independents did not submit nomination papers. The appearance of several masked men at the BJP’s election rally in Agartala stirred controversy, with CPI(M) and Congress registering complaints to the state election commission. The Congress also lodged a complaint at the West Agartala Police Station. Secretary of the State Election Commission on Monday (November 23) said they received complaints about the issues and forwarded them to the police headquarters for necessary action. He said the commission would ensure free and peaceful elections. BJP sources said veteran minister and city campaign in-charge Ratan Lal Nath organised the procession. They said the masked youths were actually party supporters from Mohanpur, north of Agartala, home Assembly constituency of minister Nath. CPI(M) and Congress, however, claimed the masked men were actually anti-socials who were likely to be engaged in creating trouble and rig the elections. They also complained of the silence of the police in initiating action despite registering complaints.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: Tripura / Communist Party of India -Marxist / Indian National Congress / Bharatiya Janata Party

articles.title: Close to realising PM Narendra Modi’s dream for Kashmir, says Kiren Rijiju
articles.examRelevance: GS Paper-II & Polity: Constitutional Amendments, Supreme Court Judgements, Parliamentary Bills & Governance Schemes
fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: ‘I remember there were no large programmes as we visited frontier districts to meet soldiers and discuss how to realise the dream of PM Modi,’ said Kiren Rijiju

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: Terming the work of J&K Waqf Board as “the best-performing” in the country, Union Minister of Parliamentary Affairs and Minority Affairs Kiren Rijiju on Monday (November 23, 2026) said the region is close to achieve the dream Prime Minister Narendra Modi has for it. Recalling his past tours of Kashmir as Minister of State (MOS) Home and as Law Minister, Mr. Rijiju said, “I remember there were no large programmes as we visited frontier districts to meet soldiers and discuss how to realise the dream of PM Modi. I must say we are very close to realising the dream PM Modi had for Kashmir. He set a goal not only for a peaceful region but also to take J&K to new heights,” said Mr. Rijiju, while speaking at the Waqf Day-2026 at the Sher-e-Kashmir University of Agricultural Sciences and Technology in Srinagar. Mr. Rijiju said Kashmir was moving ahead at a very “fast pace”. “Seeing the situation today, I can say India’s and J&K’s future is bright. People of Kashmir are large hearted. Today, sportsmen across the country wait to participate in the winter games at Gulmarg every year. The concept, besides adventure and water sports, was introduced in 2019,” said Mr. Rijiju. Earlier in the day, the Union minister inaugurated the construction of Bibi Halima College of Nursing & Medical Technology (BHCNMT), at Kathi Darwaza, Rainawari, Srinagar. He said the alumni of the educational institute included 16 Kashmir University Gold Medalists, the highest among nursing colleges and over 10 international NCLEX qualifiers in the USA and Canada. “Its graduates also constitute around 30% of nursing officers at SKIMS and over 25% of the nursing workforce at Government Medical College-associated hospitals,” he added. Praising the arrangements and management at the Nursing College and also the works done at the Hazratnal shrine, Mr. Rijiju said, “The space created at Hazratbal for female pilgrims to offer prayers is beautiful and aesthetically pleasing. I congratulate the Chairperson of the Waqf Board, Darakhshan Andrabi, in this regard. It’s the best performing board in the country.” The Union Minister also highlighted the need to properly utilise and manage over nine lakh Waqf properties across the country. “It could bring significant socio-economic changes in the Muslim community. Poor and disadvantaged members of the Muslim community could benefit considerably if Waqf assets were utilised for their welfare, of which the J&K Waqf Board’s functioning is an example,” said Mr. Rijiju. He also congratulated Ms. Andrabi and her entire team for “undertaking development initiatives and improving facilities at important religious and public institutions”. Praising PM Modi for his vision. Mr. Andrabi said, “I became the first woman chairperson in 2022 and the board was constituted. There was no official structure then and the same was put in place. It is paying dividends.” National Conference (NC) leader and Member of Parliament (MP) Mian Altaf highlighted the role of Mr. Rijiju pertaining to Kashmir. “He [Rijiju] frequently visits Kashmir and has always loved people. He always tried to contribute to Kashmir as he held different ministries. We all dream to have a better Kashmir, even what it was 30 years ago. My sister Ms. Andrabi is doing work that deserves applaud too,” said Mr. Altaf.
3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: Jammu and Kashmir National Conference / national government / Narendra Modi

hinglishTracks.en: He set a goal not only for a peaceful region but also to take J&K to new heights,” said Mr.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: देखिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का सीधा सा मतलब समझिये — उन्होंने न केवल एक शांतिपूर्ण क्षेत्र के लिए बल्कि जम्मू-कश्मीर को नई ऊंचाइयों पर ले जाने का भी लक्ष्य रखा, ”श्री ने कहा।।

hinglishTracks.en: Rijiju, while speaking at the Waqf Day-2026 at the Sher-e-Kashmir University of Agricultural Sciences and Technology in Srinagar.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: ज़रा ध्यान दीजियेगा, यहाँ मुख्य बात यह है कि — रिजिजू, श्रीनगर में शेर-ए-कश्मीर कृषि विज्ञान और प्रौद्योगिकी विश्वविद्यालय में वक्फ दिवस-2026 में बोलते हुए।। नोट कर लीजिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का वर्ड 'Agricultural' एग्जाम के लिए बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है! इसका अर्थ है: कृषि — इस अनुच्छेद में 'Agricultural' का प्रयोग एक महत्वपूर्ण प्रशासनिक और विश्लेषणात्मक अर्थ में किया गया है। इसके Synonyms हैं: Comprehensive, Influential, Decisive और Antonyms हैं: Superficial, Ineffective, Fragile।

hinglishTracks.en: Rijiju said Kashmir was moving ahead at a very “fast pace”.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: आसान हिंग्लिश भाषा में इसे समझें तो — रिजिजू ने कहा कि कश्मीर बहुत तेज गति से आगे बढ़ रहा है।।

hinglishTracks.en: “Seeing the situation today, I can say India’s and J&K’s future is bright.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: देखिये, एग्जाम के नज़रिये से यह पॉइंट बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है — “आज की स्थिति को देखकर, मैं कह सकता हूं कि भारत और जम्मू-कश्मीर का भविष्य उज्ज्वल है।।

hinglishTracks.en: People of Kashmir are large hearted.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: चलिए, अब इस अगली लाइन का असली मतलब देखते हैं — कश्मीर के लोग बड़े दिल वाले हैं.।

hinglishTracks.en: Today, sportsmen across the country wait to participate in the winter games at Gulmarg every year.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: देखिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का सीधा सा मतलब समझिये — आज, देश भर के खिलाड़ी हर साल गुलमर्ग में शीतकालीन खेलों में भाग लेने का इंतजार करते हैं।।

hinglishTracks.en: The concept, besides adventure and water sports, was introduced in 2019,” said Mr.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: ज़रा ध्यान दीजियेगा, यहाँ मुख्य बात यह है कि — साहसिक और जल खेलों के अलावा, इस अवधारणा को 2019 में पेश किया गया था, ”श्री ने कहा।।

hinglishTracks.en: Earlier in the day, the Union minister inaugurated the construction of Bibi Halima College of Nursing & Medical Technology (BHCNMT), at Kathi Darwaza, Rainawari, Srinagar.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: आसान हिंग्लिश भाषा में इसे समझें तो — इससे पहले दिन में, केंद्रीय मंत्री ने काठी दरवाजा, रैनावारी, श्रीनगर में बीबी हलीमा कॉलेज ऑफ नर्सिंग एंड मेडिकल टेक्नोलॉजी (बीएचसीएनएमटी) के निर्माण का उद्घाटन किया।।

hinglishTracks.en: He said the alumni of the educational institute included 16 Kashmir University Gold Medalists, the highest among nursing colleges and over 10 international NCLEX qualifiers in the USA and Canada.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: देखिये, एग्जाम के नज़रिये से यह पॉइंट बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है — उन्होंने कहा कि शैक्षणिक संस्थान के पूर्व छात्रों में 16 कश्मीर विश्वविद्यालय के स्वर्ण पदक विजेता, नर्सिंग कॉलेजों में सबसे अधिक और संयुक्त राज्य अमेरिका और कनाडा में 10 से अधिक अंतरराष्ट्रीय एनसीएलईएक्स क्वालीफायर शामिल हैं।। नोट कर लीजिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का वर्ड 'Institutional' एग्जाम के लिए बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है! इसका अर्थ है: संस्थागत — देश की संवैधानिक या सरकारी संस्थाओं के नियमों और ढांचे से जुड़ा हुआ। इसके Synonyms हैं: Systemic, Organizational, Constitutional और Antonyms हैं: Individual, Informal, Unorganized।

hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: चलिए, अब इस अगली लाइन का असली मतलब देखते हैं — उन्होंने कहा, "इसके स्नातक एसकेआईएमएस में लगभग 30% नर्सिंग अधिकारी और सरकारी मेडिकल कॉलेज से जुड़े अस्पतालों में 25% से अधिक नर्सिंग कार्यबल हैं।"। नोट कर लीजिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का वर्ड 'Constitutional' एग्जाम के लिए बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है! इसका अर्थ है: संवैधानिक — देश के संविधान (Constitution) के दायरे और मौलिक अधिकारों के अनुरूप। इसके Synonyms हैं: Statutory, Legitimate, Lawful और Antonyms हैं: Unconstitutional, Illegal, Arbitrary।

hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: ज़रा ध्यान दीजियेगा, यहाँ मुख्य बात यह है कि — रिजिजू ने कहा, “महिला तीर्थयात्रियों के लिए प्रार्थना करने के लिए हजरतबल में बनाया गया स्थान सुंदर और सौंदर्य की दृष्टि से मनभावन है।।

🏛️ Political, National & Polity Paragraph #9 of 30 (24 NOV)

📰 Close to realising PM Narendra Modi’s dream for Kashmir, says Kiren Rijiju

📌 Published: 24 Nov 2026, 02:32:38 AM
🎙️ Desi Hinglish Voice Educator • 🚂 Live Train Line Highlight & Screen Lock

1. Core Context & Background: ‘I remember there were no large programmes as we visited frontier districts to meet soldiers and discuss how to realise the dream of PM Modi,’ said Kiren Rijiju

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: Terming the work of J&K Waqf Board as “the best-performing” in the country, Union Minister of Parliamentary Affairs and Minority Affairs Kiren Rijiju on Monday (November 23, 2026) said the region is close to achieve the dream Prime Minister Narendra Modi has for it. Recalling his past tours of Kashmir as Minister of State (MOS) Home and as Law Minister, Mr. Rijiju said, “I remember there were no large programmes as we visited frontier districts to meet soldiers and discuss how to realise the dream of PM Modi. I must say we are very close to realising the dream PM Modi had for Kashmir. He set a goal not only for a peaceful region but also to take J&K to new heights,” said Mr. Rijiju, while speaking at the Waqf Day-2026 at the Sher-e-Kashmir University of Agricultural Sciences and Technology in Srinagar. Mr. Rijiju said Kashmir was moving ahead at a very “fast pace”. “Seeing the situation today, I can say India’s and J&K’s future is bright. People of Kashmir are large hearted. Today, sportsmen across the country wait to participate in the winter games at Gulmarg every year. The concept, besides adventure and water sports, was introduced in 2019,” said Mr. Rijiju. Earlier in the day, the Union minister inaugurated the construction of Bibi Halima College of Nursing & Medical Technology (BHCNMT), at Kathi Darwaza, Rainawari, Srinagar. He said the alumni of the educational institute included 16 Kashmir University Gold Medalists, the highest among nursing colleges and over 10 international NCLEX qualifiers in the USA and Canada. “Its graduates also constitute around 30% of nursing officers at SKIMS and over 25% of the nursing workforce at Government Medical College-associated hospitals,” he added. Praising the arrangements and management at the Nursing College and also the works done at the Hazratnal shrine, Mr. Rijiju said, “The space created at Hazratbal for female pilgrims to offer prayers is beautiful and aesthetically pleasing. I congratulate the Chairperson of the Waqf Board, Darakhshan Andrabi, in this regard. It’s the best performing board in the country.” The Union Minister also highlighted the need to properly utilise and manage over nine lakh Waqf properties across the country. “It could bring significant socio-economic changes in the Muslim community. Poor and disadvantaged members of the Muslim community could benefit considerably if Waqf assets were utilised for their welfare, of which the J&K Waqf Board’s functioning is an example,” said Mr. Rijiju. He also congratulated Ms. Andrabi and her entire team for “undertaking development initiatives and improving facilities at important religious and public institutions”. Praising PM Modi for his vision. Mr. Andrabi said, “I became the first woman chairperson in 2022 and the board was constituted. There was no official structure then and the same was put in place. It is paying dividends.” National Conference (NC) leader and Member of Parliament (MP) Mian Altaf highlighted the role of Mr. Rijiju pertaining to Kashmir. “He [Rijiju] frequently visits Kashmir and has always loved people. He always tried to contribute to Kashmir as he held different ministries. We all dream to have a better Kashmir, even what it was 30 years ago. My sister Ms. Andrabi is doing work that deserves applaud too,” said Mr. Altaf.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: Jammu and Kashmir National Conference / national government / Narendra Modi

📚 TOP 4 HARD VOCABULARY WORDS EXTRACTED FROM THIS PARAGRAPH (TAP CARD FOR PICTURE & SYNONYMS):
Institutional (Adjective)
संस्थागत — देश की संवैधानिक या सरकारी संस्थाओं के नियमों और ढांचे से जुड़ा हुआ।
✓ Syn: Systemic, Organizational, Constitutional  |  ✖ Ant: Individual, Informal, Unorganized
Constitutional (Adjective)
संवैधानिक — देश के संविधान (Constitution) के दायरे और मौलिक अधिकारों के अनुरूप।
✓ Syn: Statutory, Legitimate, Lawful  |  ✖ Ant: Unconstitutional, Illegal, Arbitrary
International (Adjective)
महत्वपूर्ण विश्लेषणात्मक शब्द — इस लेख में 'International' मुख्य प्रभाव और नीतिगत स्थिति को स्पष्ट करता है।
