✍️ Editorial & Opinion Paragraph #3 of 30 (23 NOV)

📰 Core accountability: On core sector performance

📌 Published: 23 Nov 2026, 01:09:58 AM
🎙️ Desi Hinglish Voice Educator • 🚂 Live Train Line Highlight & Screen Lock

1. Core Context & Background: Even a low base effect could not push India’s oil and gas sectors into growth

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: The core sector performance in October is a good example of how statistical distortions can create incorrect assessments of the economy. The 10.9% growth rate, a series high, has been celebrated as a sign of the Indian economy’s strength and resilience. There is, no doubt, an aspect of this has been reflected in the numbers, especially to do with infrastructure creation. However, the much more impactful factor behind the high core sector growth was a low base effect. The overall Index of Core Industries grew just 0.8% in October 2025 and so, in relation, the performance in October 2026 looked that much faster. This low base effect is even starker when looking at individual sectors within the index. The coal sector grew at a blistering 23% in October, more than twice its growth rate in the previous month. Yet, a large part of this was propelled by the fact that the sector had contracted nearly 8.5% last October. The rest of the sector’s growth was driven by demand of the electricity and iron ore sectors, or so the data show. The electricity sector also grew at a series high of nearly 22% in October, but on the back of a near-7% contraction in October last year. This base effect anomaly is likely down to the fact that the festive season starts at different but similar points every year. As such, a more accurate reading of the economy will be possible once the data for November are available.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: The construction-related sectors seem to have seen genuine growth, a reflection of the government’s ongoing infrastructure push. The iron ore sector’s growth rate accelerated to a three-month high of 26.4% in October 2026 as compared to a growth of 8.7% in the same month last year. Steel grew at 7.3% versus 9.5% last year, and cement by 15.4% versus 5.2%. The economy’s dependence on government spending is not going to ease in the near future, and might even intensify as higher costs eat into companies’ profit margins. The core sector data once again highlighted a major reason for these higher costs — the oil and gas sectors. The crude oil sector shrank by 4.1%, its 22nd consecutive month of contraction. The natural gas sector, similarly, contracted 7.6%, a series-worst performance and the 28th straight month of contraction. A major reason behind high inflation in India is the underperformance of these two sectors and the resultant dependence on imported fuel. It is time the Petroleum Ministry candidly explains — to Parliament in December or to the public directly — why India’s fuel output has been continuously falling. If it is a matter of a lack of resources underground, that is one thing, but the underperformance of oil and gas public sector undertakings is quite another. Accountability needs to be set.

📚 TOP 4 HARD VOCABULARY WORDS EXTRACTED FROM THIS PARAGRAPH (TAP CARD FOR PICTURE & SYNONYMS):
Accountability (Noun)
जवाबदेही — अपने फैसलों और काम का जनता तथा संविधान को हिसाब देने की बाध्यता।
✓ Syn: Responsibility, Answerability, Liability  |  ✖ Ant: Immunity, Exemption, Irresponsibility
Resilience (Noun)
लचीलापन और मज़बूती — किसी बड़े संकट या मंदी के बाद तेज़ी से वापस उभरने की क्षमता।
✓ Syn: Robustness, Endurance, Adaptability  |  ✖ Ant: Fragility, Vulnerability, Weakness
Inflation (Noun)
महंगाई (मुद्रास्फीति) — जब बाज़ार में वस्तुओं के दाम बढ़ें और रुपये की खरीद शक्ति कम हो जाए।
✓ Syn: Price-escalation, Hyperinflation, Dearness  |  ✖ Ant: Deflation, Disinflation, Recession
Underperformance (Adjective / Verb)
महत्वपूर्ण विश्लेषणात्मक शब्द — इस लेख में 'Underperformance' मुख्य प्रभाव और नीतिगत स्थिति को स्पष्ट करता है।
✓ Syn: Restrictive, Counteractive, Adverse  |  ✖ Ant: Constructive, Supportive, Favorable
🧠 2 ANALYTICAL EXAM QUESTIONS BASED ON THIS EDITORIAL:

articles.keyPoints:
• 1. Core Context & Background: Even a low base effect could not push India’s oil and gas sectors into growth
• 2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: The core sector performance in October is a good example of how statistical distortions can create incorrect assessments of the economy. The 10.9% growth rate, a series high, has been celebrated as a sign of the Indian economy’s strength and resilience. There is, no doubt, an aspect of this has been reflected in the numbers, especially to do with infrastructure creation. However, the much more impactful factor behind the high core sector growth was a low base effect. The overall Index of Core Industries grew just 0.8% in October 2025 and so, in relation, the performance in October 2026 looked that much faster. This low base effect is even starker when looking at individual sectors within the index. The coal sector grew at a blistering 23% in October, more than twice its growth rate in the previous month. Yet, a large part of this was propelled by the fact that the sector had contracted nearly 8.5% last October. The rest of the sector’s growth was driven by demand of the electricity and iron ore sectors, or so the data show. The electricity sector also grew at a series high of nearly 22% in October, but on the back of a near-7% contraction in October last year. This base effect anomaly is likely down to the fact that the festive season starts at different but similar points every year. As such, a more accurate reading of the economy will be possible once the data for November are available.
• 3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: The construction-related sectors seem to have seen genuine growth, a reflection of the government’s ongoing infrastructure push. The iron ore sector’s growth rate accelerated to a three-month high of 26.4% in October 2026 as compared to a growth of 8.7% in the same month last year. Steel grew at 7.3% versus 9.5% last year, and cement by 15.4% versus 5.2%. The economy’s dependence on government spending is not going to ease in the near future, and might even intensify as higher costs eat into companies’ profit margins. The core sector data once again highlighted a major reason for these higher costs — the oil and gas sectors. The crude oil sector shrank by 4.1%, its 22nd consecutive month of contraction. The natural gas sector, similarly, contracted 7.6%, a series-worst performance and the 28th straight month of contraction. A major reason behind high inflation in India is the underperformance of these two sectors and the resultant dependence on imported fuel. It is time the Petroleum Ministry candidly explains — to Parliament in December or to the public directly — why India’s fuel output has been continuously falling. If it is a matter of a lack of resources underground, that is one thing, but the underperformance of oil and gas public sector undertakings is quite another. Accountability needs to be set.

articles.title: Paper tiger: On the Green India Mission
articles.examRelevance: UPSC, State PSC, SSC & Banking Mains: Deep Analytical Core Summary, Policy Critique, 4 Hinglish Vocab & 2 Analytical Questions
fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: Climate action has to be timely, with adequate resources and monitoring

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: That all was not well with the Green India Mission was clear even before its approval. After the UPA-I government announced it in 2008, the Ministry of Rural Development had objected to its financial design much before the Union Cabinet approved it in 2014. But the Environment Ministry proceeded anyway and retained largely the same arrangement when it revised the Mission in 2021. Following the Comptroller and Auditor General’s report, on November 19, the Public Accounts Committee (PAC) upbraided the Ministry for the Mission’s virtual failure and for still not having issued the implementation guidelines for the revised form. The original 10-year vision was to expand forest and tree cover by 5 million hectares (mha), improve forest quality on another 5 mha, improve forest-related livelihoods for 3 million households, and sequester up to 60 million tonnes of carbon dioxide a year. The outlay was ₹46,000 crore. In 2014, the Cabinet approved ₹13,000 crore for 1.4 mha each of the first two objectives by 2018, but to be supported to the tune of 81.5% by Compensatory Afforestation Fund Management and Planning Authority (CAMPA), National Afforestation Programme (NAP), and MGNREGS funds. In 2021-22, the Ministry folded the NAP into the Mission and, in mid-2025, unveiled a revised version with an allocation of ₹12,190 crore to improve forest cover on 25 mha by 2030, including 24 mha through other schemes. The government had thus expanded the primary target but left the Mission responsible for only 1 mha.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: Together with the CAMPA, NAP, and MGNREGS funds never materialising, it is no surprise that the programmes to improve forest quality and forest cover have respectively fallen short by 91.8% and 97.5% vis-à-vis the 2014 target. The Environment Ministry had assembled a large programme around resources that it knew it could not control. Pro-climate work in practice ought to span government schemes to deliver action and justice, and the Ministry ought to have formalised the division of responsibilities and accounting system. The PAC’s new demand that the Ministry submit an implementation timetable is insufficient. From the Jal Shakti Abhiyan in 2019 to the Dharti Aaba Janjatiya Gram Utkarsh Abhiyan in 2024, the government has often floated new programmes banking significantly on funds from existing schemes — an untenable policy when the latter also have their own obligations. And if the VB-G RAM G scheme was to also advance climate justice, the government should not have undermined the erstwhile demand-driven funding model and shifted more financial responsibility to the States. Climate action has to be timely, for which the Union government must dedicate adequate resources and proactively ensure that its initiatives are implemented.

hinglishTracks.en: That all was not well with the Green India Mission was clear even before its approval.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: ज़रा ध्यान दीजियेगा, यहाँ मुख्य बात यह है कि — ग्रीन इंडिया मिशन में सब कुछ ठीक नहीं है, यह इसकी मंजूरी से पहले ही स्पष्ट हो गया था।।

hinglishTracks.en: After the UPA-I government announced it in 2008, the Ministry of Rural Development had objected to its financial design much before the Union Cabinet approved it in 2014.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: आसान हिंग्लिश भाषा में इसे समझें तो — 2008 में यूपीए-1 सरकार द्वारा इसकी घोषणा के बाद, 2014 में केंद्रीय मंत्रिमंडल द्वारा इसे मंजूरी दिए जाने से काफी पहले ग्रामीण विकास मंत्रालय ने इसके वित्तीय डिजाइन पर आपत्ति जताई थी।।

hinglishTracks.en: But the Environment Ministry proceeded anyway and retained largely the same arrangement when it revised the Mission in 2021.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: देखिये, एग्जाम के नज़रिये से यह पॉइंट बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है — लेकिन पर्यावरण मंत्रालय फिर भी आगे बढ़ा और 2021 में मिशन को संशोधित करते समय मोटे तौर पर वही व्यवस्था बरकरार रखी।। नोट कर लीजिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का वर्ड 'Environmental' एग्जाम के लिए बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है! इसका अर्थ है: पर्यावरण, प्रकृति और हमारे पारिस्थितिकी तंत्र (Ecosystem) से संबंधित। इसके Synonyms हैं: Ecological, Biospheric, Natural और Antonyms हैं: Industrial, Polluting, Synthetic।

hinglishTracks.en: Following the Comptroller and Auditor General’s report, on November 19, the Public Accounts Committee (PAC) upbraided the Ministry for the Mission’s virtual failure and for still not having issued the implementation guidelines for the revised form.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: चलिए, अब इस अगली लाइन का असली मतलब देखते हैं — नियंत्रक एवं महालेखा परीक्षक की रिपोर्ट के बाद, 19 नवंबर को, लोक लेखा समिति (पीएसी) ने मिशन की आभासी विफलता और संशोधित फॉर्म के लिए कार्यान्वयन दिशानिर्देश जारी नहीं करने के लिए मंत्रालय को फटकार लगाई।। नोट कर लीजिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का वर्ड 'Implementation' एग्जाम के लिए बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है! इसका अर्थ है: क्रियान्वयन / ज़मीनी स्तर पर लागू करना — किसी योजना या फैसले को असलियत में पूरा करना। इसके Synonyms हैं: Execution, Enforcement, Fulfillment और Antonyms हैं: Abandonment, Neglect, Cancellation।

hinglishTracks.en: The original 10-year vision was to expand forest and tree cover by 5 million hectares (mha), improve forest quality on another 5 mha, improve forest-related livelihoods for 3 million households, and sequester up to 60 million tonnes of carbon dioxide a year.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: देखिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का सीधा सा मतलब समझिये — मूल 10-वर्षीय दृष्टिकोण वन और वृक्ष आवरण को 5 मिलियन हेक्टेयर (एमएचए) तक विस्तारित करना, अन्य 5 एमएचए पर वन की गुणवत्ता में सुधार करना, 3 मिलियन परिवारों के लिए वन-संबंधित आजीविका में सुधार करना और प्रति वर्ष 60 मिलियन टन कार्बन डाइऑक्साइड को अलग करना था।।

hinglishTracks.en: In 2014, the Cabinet approved ₹13,000 crore for 1.4 mha each of the first two objectives by 2018, but to be supported to the tune of 81.5% by Compensatory Afforestation Fund Management and Planning Authority (CAMPA), National Afforestation Programme (NAP), and MGNREGS funds.

hinglishTracks.en: In 2021-22, the Ministry folded the NAP into the Mission and, in mid-2025, unveiled a revised version with an allocation of ₹12,190 crore to improve forest cover on 25 mha by 2030, including 24 mha through other schemes.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: देखिये, एग्जाम के नज़रिये से यह पॉइंट बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है — 2021-22 में, मंत्रालय ने एनएपी को मिशन में शामिल कर लिया और 2025 के मध्य में, 2030 तक 25 एमएचए पर वन क्षेत्र में सुधार करने के लिए ₹12,190 करोड़ के आवंटन के साथ एक संशोधित संस्करण का अनावरण किया, जिसमें अन्य योजनाओं के माध्यम से 24 एमएचए भी शामिल था।।

hinglishTracks.en: The government had thus expanded the primary target but left the Mission responsible for only 1 mha.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: चलिए, अब इस अगली लाइन का असली मतलब देखते हैं — इस प्रकार सरकार ने प्राथमिक लक्ष्य का विस्तार किया लेकिन मिशन को केवल 1 मिलियन हेक्टेयर के लिए जिम्मेदार छोड़ दिया।। नोट कर लीजिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का वर्ड 'Responsibility' एग्जाम के लिए बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है! इसका अर्थ है: महत्वपूर्ण विश्लेषणात्मक शब्द — इस लेख में 'Responsibility' मुख्य प्रभाव और नीतिगत स्थिति को स्पष्ट करता है। इसके Synonyms हैं: Significant, Substantial, Strategic और Antonyms हैं: Insignificant, Negligible, Trivial।

hinglishTracks.en: Together with the CAMPA, NAP, and MGNREGS funds never materialising, it is no surprise that the programmes to improve forest quality and forest cover have respectively fallen short by 91.8% and 97.5% vis-à-vis the 2014 target.

✍️ Editorial & Opinion Paragraph #4 of 30 (23 NOV)

📰 Paper tiger: On the Green India Mission

📌 Published: 23 Nov 2026, 01:07:54 AM
🎙️ Desi Hinglish Voice Educator • 🚂 Live Train Line Highlight & Screen Lock

1. Core Context & Background: Climate action has to be timely, with adequate resources and monitoring

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: That all was not well with the Green India Mission was clear even before its approval. After the UPA-I government announced it in 2008, the Ministry of Rural Development had objected to its financial design much before the Union Cabinet approved it in 2014. But the Environment Ministry proceeded anyway and retained largely the same arrangement when it revised the Mission in 2021. Following the Comptroller and Auditor General’s report, on November 19, the Public Accounts Committee (PAC) upbraided the Ministry for the Mission’s virtual failure and for still not having issued the implementation guidelines for the revised form. The original 10-year vision was to expand forest and tree cover by 5 million hectares (mha), improve forest quality on another 5 mha, improve forest-related livelihoods for 3 million households, and sequester up to 60 million tonnes of carbon dioxide a year. The outlay was ₹46,000 crore. In 2014, the Cabinet approved ₹13,000 crore for 1.4 mha each of the first two objectives by 2018, but to be supported to the tune of 81.5% by Compensatory Afforestation Fund Management and Planning Authority (CAMPA), National Afforestation Programme (NAP), and MGNREGS funds. In 2021-22, the Ministry folded the NAP into the Mission and, in mid-2025, unveiled a revised version with an allocation of ₹12,190 crore to improve forest cover on 25 mha by 2030, including 24 mha through other schemes. The government had thus expanded the primary target but left the Mission responsible for only 1 mha.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: Together with the CAMPA, NAP, and MGNREGS funds never materialising, it is no surprise that the programmes to improve forest quality and forest cover have respectively fallen short by 91.8% and 97.5% vis-à-vis the 2014 target. The Environment Ministry had assembled a large programme around resources that it knew it could not control. Pro-climate work in practice ought to span government schemes to deliver action and justice, and the Ministry ought to have formalised the division of responsibilities and accounting system. The PAC’s new demand that the Ministry submit an implementation timetable is insufficient. From the Jal Shakti Abhiyan in 2019 to the Dharti Aaba Janjatiya Gram Utkarsh Abhiyan in 2024, the government has often floated new programmes banking significantly on funds from existing schemes — an untenable policy when the latter also have their own obligations. And if the VB-G RAM G scheme was to also advance climate justice, the government should not have undermined the erstwhile demand-driven funding model and shifted more financial responsibility to the States. Climate action has to be timely, for which the Union government must dedicate adequate resources and proactively ensure that its initiatives are implemented.

Implementation (Noun)
क्रियान्वयन / ज़मीनी स्तर पर लागू करना — किसी योजना या फैसले को असलियत में पूरा करना।

Accountability (Noun)
जवाबदेही — अपने फैसलों और काम का जनता तथा संविधान को हिसाब देने की बाध्यता।
✓ Syn: Responsibility, Answerability, Liability  |  ✖ Ant: Immunity, Exemption, Irresponsibility
Responsibility (Noun)
महत्वपूर्ण विश्लेषणात्मक शब्द — इस लेख में 'Responsibility' मुख्य प्रभाव और नीतिगत स्थिति को स्पष्ट करता है।
✓ Syn: Significant, Substantial, Strategic  |  ✖ Ant: Insignificant, Negligible, Trivial

Q1. Based on a critical reading of the above ✍️ Editorial & Opinion passage on "Paper tiger: On the Green India Mission", which of the following statements accurately reflects the central analytical observation of the text?

B. Contrary to the passage, the issue of 'Paper tiger: On the Green India Mission' requires zero institutional or regulatory intervention at any level.
C. The passage argues that all empirical data and statutory mechanisms related to 'Paper tiger: On the Green India Mission' should be permanently discontinued.
D. The author contends that 'Paper tiger: On the Green India Mission' has no bearing on public governance, economy, or citizen welfare.

B. Climate action has to be timely, for which the Union government must dedicate adequate resources and proactively ensure that its initiatives are...
C. Dismissing constitutional accountability and relying solely on unverified short-term measures.
D. Recommending the immediate suspension of all regulatory and scientific assessments mentioned in the text.
✅ Correct Answer: Option (B) — Sahi Jawab Option (B) hai. Lekhak ne passage ke vishleshan mein is baat par zor diya hai: "Climate action has to be timely, for which the Union government must dedicate adequate resources and proactively ensure that its initiatives are..." (Hinglish Arth: जलवायु कार्रवाई समय पर होनी चाहिए, जिसके लिए केंद्र सरकार को पर्याप्त संसाधन समर्पित करने चाहिए और सक्रिय रूप से यह सुनिश्चित करना चाहिए कि उसकी पहल लागू हो।)

articles.title: Incomplete remedies: On Special Summary Revision of electoral rolls
articles.examRelevance: UPSC, State PSC, SSC & Banking Mains: Deep Analytical Core Summary, Policy Critique, 4 Hinglish Vocab & 2 Analytical Questions
fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: The ECI offers relief to a section of deleted electors but SIR’s flaws remain

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: Following the Special Summary Revision (SSR) by the Election Commission of India (ECI) in some States that had undergone the Special Intensive Revision (SIR) , mostly in Phases 1 and 2, some 74 lakh names were added onto the electoral rolls. This meant that the electorate in those 13 States, that had shrunk from 49.61 crore to 45.22 crore after the SIR, has now gone up to 45.96 crore. The ECI has extended the SSR to States and UTs in Phase 3. As before, it requires no proof of citizenship or mapping to older rolls, and insists on personal notice before any deletion other than of the dead. It also directs Electoral Registration Officers (EROs) to cross-verify deletions personally wherever they exceed 2% of a polling station’s electors. Draft deletions in Phase 3 of the SIR averaged 17% , and reached 32.8% in Delhi . The ECI also offered another opportunity to electors deleted by the SIR in the seven States and UTs where it is still underway, such as Delhi and Maharashtra, to return to the rolls. Electors who did not return their forms can do so now, explaining the delay, and those who moved within the State can return through the enumeration form with proof of their new address. EROs will process these forms under Rule 21(1) of the Registration of Electors Rules, 1960, and restore the elector’s old EPIC number. These “corrective” measures follow the Supreme Court’s observation on October 28 that forcing deleted electors to re-enrol through Form 6, meant for new voters, was an “error”. The ECI’s use of remedies that existed in the registration rules is a tacit admission that it went wrong during the SIR. But the measures are limited. They reach roughly 4.5 crore of the 13.37 crore struck off the draft rolls and do not cover electors who moved out of their States. Electors in States where the SIR has concluded, including Bihar and West Bengal, which have already voted on the SIR rolls, can return only through the SSR, by filing Form 6 as new voters, with fresh EPIC numbers and no record that they were ever on the roll. In essence, the structure of the SIR remains intact. Electors must still provide details from “the last SIR”, and those whose details are unavailable or do not match will be asked for documents in a manner that amounts to a citizenship test. The legality of the ludicrous “logical discrepancy” checks remains unaddressed. The 2002-03 special revision offered a better way. Those who had shifted homes were enumerated door to door at their new addresses. The Supreme Court must direct the ECI to return to that model.
3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: Election Commission of India / Special Intensive Revision of electoral rolls / election / India

ultraAnalyticalQuestions2.question: Which of the following key analytical points or conclusions is explicitly highlighted by the author in the passage regarding "Incomplete remedies: On Special Summary Revision of electoral rolls"?
options: Advocating complete policy paralysis and ignoring ground-level implementation challenges.
Election Commission of India / Special Intensive Revision of electoral rolls / election / India.
Dismissing constitutional accountability and relying solely on unverified short-term measures.
Recommending the immediate suspension of all regulatory and scientific assessments mentioned in the text.
ultraAnalyticalQuestions2.answerText: Election Commission of India / Special Intensive Revision of electoral rolls / election / India.
ultraAnalyticalQuestions2.hinglishExplanation: Sahi Jawab Option (B) hai. Lekhak ne passage ke vishleshan mein is baat par zor diya hai: "Election Commission of India / Special Intensive Revision of electoral rolls / election / India." (Hinglish Arth: भारत निर्वाचन आयोग/निर्वाचक नामावलियों का विशेष गहन पुनरीक्षण/निर्वाचन/भारत)

hinglishTracks.en: The ECI offers relief to a section of deleted electors but SIR’s flaws remain
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: देखिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का सीधा सा मतलब समझिये — ईसीआई हटाए गए मतदाताओं के एक वर्ग को राहत प्रदान करता है लेकिन एसआईआर की खामियां बनी हुई हैं।

hinglishTracks.en: Following the Special Summary Revision (SSR) by the Election Commission of India (ECI) in some States that had undergone the Special Intensive Revision (SIR) , mostly in Phases 1 and 2, some 74 lakh names were added onto the electoral rolls.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: ज़रा ध्यान दीजियेगा, यहाँ मुख्य बात यह है कि — भारत के चुनाव आयोग (ईसीआई) द्वारा विशेष गहन पुनरीक्षण (एसआईआर) से गुजरने वाले कुछ राज्यों में, ज्यादातर चरण 1 और 2 में, विशेष सारांश संशोधन (एसएसआर) के बाद, लगभग 74 लाख नाम मतदाता सूची में जोड़े गए थे।।

hinglishTracks.en: This meant that the electorate in those 13 States, that had shrunk from 49.61 crore to 45.22 crore after the SIR, has now gone up to 45.96 crore.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: आसान हिंग्लिश भाषा में इसे समझें तो — इसका मतलब यह हुआ कि उन 13 राज्यों में मतदाता, जो एसआईआर के बाद 49.61 करोड़ से घटकर 45.22 करोड़ हो गए थे, अब 45.96 करोड़ हो गए हैं।।

hinglishTracks.en: The ECI has extended the SSR to States and UTs in Phase 3.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: देखिये, एग्जाम के नज़रिये से यह पॉइंट बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है — ईसीआई ने चरण 3 में एसएसआर को राज्यों और केंद्रशासित प्रदेशों तक बढ़ा दिया है।।

hinglishTracks.en: As before, it requires no proof of citizenship or mapping to older rolls, and insists on personal notice before any deletion other than of the dead.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: चलिए, अब इस अगली लाइन का असली मतलब देखते हैं — पहले की तरह, इसमें नागरिकता के प्रमाण या पुरानी सूची में मैपिंग की आवश्यकता नहीं है, और मृतकों के अलावा किसी भी अन्य नाम को हटाने से पहले व्यक्तिगत नोटिस पर जोर देता है।।

hinglishTracks.en: It also directs Electoral Registration Officers (EROs) to cross-verify deletions personally wherever they exceed 2% of a polling station’s electors.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: देखिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का सीधा सा मतलब समझिये — यह निर्वाचक पंजीकरण अधिकारियों (ईआरओ) को यह भी निर्देश देता है कि जहां भी मतदान केंद्र के मतदाताओं की संख्या 2% से अधिक हो, वहां विलोपन को व्यक्तिगत रूप से सत्यापित करें।। नोट कर लीजिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का वर्ड 'Registration' एग्जाम के लिए बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है! इसका अर्थ है: पंजीकरण — इस अनुच्छेद में 'Registration' का प्रयोग एक महत्वपूर्ण प्रशासनिक और विश्लेषणात्मक अर्थ में किया गया है। इसके Synonyms हैं: Significant, Substantial, Strategic और Antonyms हैं: Insignificant, Negligible, Trivial।

hinglishTracks.en: Draft deletions in Phase 3 of the SIR averaged 17% , and reached 32.8% in Delhi .
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: ज़रा ध्यान दीजियेगा, यहाँ मुख्य बात यह है कि — एसआईआर के चरण 3 में ड्राफ्ट विलोपन का औसत 17% था, और दिल्ली में यह 32.8% तक पहुंच गया।।

hinglishTracks.en: The ECI also offered another opportunity to electors deleted by the SIR in the seven States and UTs where it is still underway, such as Delhi and Maharashtra, to return to the rolls.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: आसान हिंग्लिश भाषा में इसे समझें तो — ईसीआई ने उन सात राज्यों और केंद्रशासित प्रदेशों में एसआईआर द्वारा हटाए गए मतदाताओं को, जहां यह अभी भी चल रहा है, जैसे कि दिल्ली और महाराष्ट्र में, नामावली में वापस लौटने का एक और अवसर प्रदान किया।। नोट कर लीजिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का वर्ड 'Opportunity' एग्जाम के लिए बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है! इसका अर्थ है: अवसर — इस अनुच्छेद में 'Opportunity' का प्रयोग एक महत्वपूर्ण प्रशासनिक और विश्लेषणात्मक अर्थ में किया गया है। इसके Synonyms हैं: Significant, Substantial, Strategic और Antonyms हैं: Insignificant, Negligible, Trivial।

hinglishTracks.en: Electors who did not return their forms can do so now, explaining the delay, and those who moved within the State can return through the enumeration form with proof of their new address.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: देखिये, एग्जाम के नज़रिये से यह पॉइंट बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है — जिन निर्वाचकों ने अपने फॉर्म वापस नहीं किए थे, वे विलंब को समझाते हुए अब ऐसा कर सकते हैं, और जो राज्य के भीतर चले गए हैं वे अपने नए पते के प्रमाण के साथ गणना फॉर्म के माध्यम से वापस आ सकते हैं।। नोट कर लीजिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का वर्ड 'Enumeration' एग्जाम के लिए बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है! इसका अर्थ है: गणना — इस अनुच्छेद में 'Enumeration' का प्रयोग एक महत्वपूर्ण प्रशासनिक और विश्लेषणात्मक अर्थ में किया गया है। इसके Synonyms हैं: Significant, Substantial, Strategic और Antonyms हैं: Insignificant, Negligible, Trivial।

hinglishTracks.en: EROs will process these forms under Rule 21(1) of the Registration of Electors Rules, 1960, and restore the elector’s old EPIC number.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: चलिए, अब इस अगली लाइन का असली मतलब देखते हैं — ईआरओ इन फॉर्मों को निर्वाचक पंजीकरण नियम, 1960 के नियम 21(1) के तहत संसाधित करेंगे और निर्वाचक के पुराने ईपीआईसी नंबर को बहाल करेंगे।। नोट कर लीजिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का वर्ड 'Registration' एग्जाम के लिए बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है! इसका अर्थ है: पंजीकरण — इस अनुच्छेद में 'Registration' का प्रयोग एक महत्वपूर्ण प्रशासनिक और विश्लेषणात्मक अर्थ में किया गया है। इसके Synonyms हैं: Significant, Substantial, Strategic और Antonyms हैं: Insignificant, Negligible, Trivial।

hinglishTracks.en: These “corrective” measures follow the Supreme Court’s observation on October 28 that forcing deleted electors to re-enrol through Form 6, meant for new voters, was an “error”.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: देखिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का सीधा सा मतलब समझिये — ये "सुधारात्मक" उपाय 28 अक्टूबर को सुप्रीम कोर्ट की टिप्पणी का पालन करते हैं कि हटाए गए मतदाताओं को नए मतदाताओं के लिए फॉर्म 6 के माध्यम से फिर से नामांकन करने के लिए मजबूर करना एक "त्रुटि" थी।। नोट कर लीजिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का वर्ड 'Observation' एग्जाम के लिए बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है! इसका अर्थ है: अवलोकन — इस अनुच्छेद में 'Observation' का प्रयोग एक महत्वपूर्ण प्रशासनिक और विश्लेषणात्मक अर्थ में किया गया है। इसके Synonyms हैं: Significant, Substantial, Strategic और Antonyms हैं: Insignificant, Negligible, Trivial।

hinglishTracks.en: The ECI’s use of remedies that existed in the registration rules is a tacit admission that it went wrong during the SIR.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: ज़रा ध्यान दीजियेगा, यहाँ मुख्य बात यह है कि — ईसीआई द्वारा पंजीकरण नियमों में मौजूद उपायों का उपयोग एक मौन स्वीकृति है कि एसआईआर के दौरान यह गलत हुआ।। नोट कर लीजिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का वर्ड 'Registration' एग्जाम के लिए बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है! इसका अर्थ है: पंजीकरण — इस अनुच्छेद में 'Registration' का प्रयोग एक महत्वपूर्ण प्रशासनिक और विश्लेषणात्मक अर्थ में किया गया है। इसके Synonyms हैं: Significant, Substantial, Strategic और Antonyms हैं: Insignificant, Negligible, Trivial।

hinglishTracks.en: But the measures are limited.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: आसान हिंग्लिश भाषा में इसे समझें तो — लेकिन उपाय सीमित हैं.।

hinglishTracks.en: They reach roughly 4.5 crore of the 13.37 crore struck off the draft rolls and do not cover electors who moved out of their States.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: देखिये, एग्जाम के नज़रिये से यह पॉइंट बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है — वे ड्राफ्ट रोल से बाहर किए गए 13.37 करोड़ में से लगभग 4.5 करोड़ तक पहुंचते हैं और उन मतदाताओं को कवर नहीं करते हैं जो अपने राज्यों से बाहर चले गए हैं।।

hinglishTracks.en: Electors in States where the SIR has concluded, including Bihar and West Bengal, which have already voted on the SIR rolls, can return only through the SSR, by filing Form 6 as new voters, with fresh EPIC numbers and no record that they were ever on the roll.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: चलिए, अब इस अगली लाइन का असली मतलब देखते हैं — बिहार और पश्चिम बंगाल सहित जिन राज्यों में एसआईआर समाप्त हो गया है, वहां के मतदाता, जो पहले ही एसआईआर रोल पर मतदान कर चुके हैं, नए ईपीआईसी नंबरों के साथ नए मतदाताओं के रूप में फॉर्म 6 दाखिल करके केवल एसएसआर के माध्यम से लौट सकते हैं और इस बात का कोई रिकॉर्ड नहीं है कि वे कभी भी एसआईआर रोल में थे।।

hinglishTracks.en: In essence, the structure of the SIR remains intact.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: देखिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का सीधा सा मतलब समझिये — संक्षेप में, एसआईआर की संरचना बरकरार रहती है।।

hinglishTracks.en: Electors must still provide details from “the last SIR”, and those whose details are unavailable or do not match will be asked for documents in a manner that amounts to a citizenship test.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: ज़रा ध्यान दीजियेगा, यहाँ मुख्य बात यह है कि — मतदाताओं को अभी भी "अंतिम एसआईआर" से विवरण प्रदान करना होगा, और जिनके विवरण अनुपलब्ध हैं या मेल नहीं खाते हैं, उनसे इस तरह से दस्तावेज़ मांगे जाएंगे जो नागरिकता परीक्षण के समान होगा।।

hinglishTracks.en: The legality of the ludicrous “logical discrepancy” checks remains unaddressed.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: आसान हिंग्लिश भाषा में इसे समझें तो — हास्यास्पद "तार्किक विसंगति" जांच की वैधता पर ध्यान नहीं दिया गया है।।

hinglishTracks.en: The 2002-03 special revision offered a better way.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: देखिये, एग्जाम के नज़रिये से यह पॉइंट बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है — 2002-03 के विशेष संशोधन ने एक बेहतर तरीका पेश किया।।

hinglishTracks.en: Those who had shifted homes were enumerated door to door at their new addresses.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: चलिए, अब इस अगली लाइन का असली मतलब देखते हैं — जो लोग घर बदल चुके थे, उनके नए पते पर घर-घर जाकर गणना की गई।। नोट कर लीजिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का वर्ड 'Enumeration' एग्जाम के लिए बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है! इसका अर्थ है: गणना — इस अनुच्छेद में 'Enumeration' का प्रयोग एक महत्वपूर्ण प्रशासनिक और विश्लेषणात्मक अर्थ में किया गया है। इसके Synonyms हैं: Significant, Substantial, Strategic और Antonyms हैं: Insignificant, Negligible, Trivial।

hinglishTracks.en: The Supreme Court must direct the ECI to return to that model.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: देखिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का सीधा सा मतलब समझिये — सुप्रीम कोर्ट को ईसीआई को उस मॉडल पर लौटने का निर्देश देना चाहिए।।

hinglishTracks.en: Election Commission of India / Special Intensive Revision of electoral rolls / election / India
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: ज़रा ध्यान दीजियेगा, यहाँ मुख्य बात यह है कि — भारत निर्वाचन आयोग/निर्वाचक नामावलियों का विशेष गहन पुनरीक्षण/निर्वाचन/भारत।

✍️ Editorial & Opinion Paragraph #5 of 30 (23 NOV)

📰 Incomplete remedies: On Special Summary Revision of electoral rolls

📌 Published: 23 Nov 2026, 07:28:59 PM IST
🎙️ Desi Hinglish Voice Educator • 🚂 Live Train Line Highlight & Screen Lock

1. Core Context & Background: The ECI offers relief to a section of deleted electors but SIR’s flaws remain

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: Following the Special Summary Revision (SSR) by the Election Commission of India (ECI) in some States that had undergone the Special Intensive Revision (SIR) , mostly in Phases 1 and 2, some 74 lakh names were added onto the electoral rolls. This meant that the electorate in those 13 States, that had shrunk from 49.61 crore to 45.22 crore after the SIR, has now gone up to 45.96 crore. The ECI has extended the SSR to States and UTs in Phase 3. As before, it requires no proof of citizenship or mapping to older rolls, and insists on personal notice before any deletion other than of the dead. It also directs Electoral Registration Officers (EROs) to cross-verify deletions personally wherever they exceed 2% of a polling station’s electors. Draft deletions in Phase 3 of the SIR averaged 17% , and reached 32.8% in Delhi . The ECI also offered another opportunity to electors deleted by the SIR in the seven States and UTs where it is still underway, such as Delhi and Maharashtra, to return to the rolls. Electors who did not return their forms can do so now, explaining the delay, and those who moved within the State can return through the enumeration form with proof of their new address. EROs will process these forms under Rule 21(1) of the Registration of Electors Rules, 1960, and restore the elector’s old EPIC number. These “corrective” measures follow the Supreme Court’s observation on October 28 that forcing deleted electors to re-enrol through Form 6, meant for new voters, was an “error”. The ECI’s use of remedies that existed in the registration rules is a tacit admission that it went wrong during the SIR. But the measures are limited. They reach roughly 4.5 crore of the 13.37 crore struck off the draft rolls and do not cover electors who moved out of their States. Electors in States where the SIR has concluded, including Bihar and West Bengal, which have already voted on the SIR rolls, can return only through the SSR, by filing Form 6 as new voters, with fresh EPIC numbers and no record that they were ever on the roll. In essence, the structure of the SIR remains intact. Electors must still provide details from “the last SIR”, and those whose details are unavailable or do not match will be asked for documents in a manner that amounts to a citizenship test. The legality of the ludicrous “logical discrepancy” checks remains unaddressed. The 2002-03 special revision offered a better way. Those who had shifted homes were enumerated door to door at their new addresses. The Supreme Court must direct the ECI to return to that model.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: Election Commission of India / Special Intensive Revision of electoral rolls / election / India

articles.keyPoints:
• 1. Core Context & Background: The ECI offers relief to a section of deleted electors but SIR’s flaws remain
• 2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: Following the Special Summary Revision (SSR) by the Election Commission of India (ECI) in some States that had undergone the Special Intensive Revision (SIR) , mostly in Phases 1 and 2, some 74 lakh names were added onto the electoral rolls. This meant that the electorate in those 13 States, that had shrunk from 49.61 crore to 45.22 crore after the SIR, has now gone up to 45.96 crore. The ECI has extended the SSR to States and UTs in Phase 3. As before, it requires no proof of citizenship or mapping to older rolls, and insists on personal notice before any deletion other than of the dead. It also directs Electoral Registration Officers (EROs) to cross-verify deletions personally wherever they exceed 2% of a polling station’s electors. Draft deletions in Phase 3 of the SIR averaged 17% , and reached 32.8% in Delhi . The ECI also offered another opportunity to electors deleted by the SIR in the seven States and UTs where it is still underway, such as Delhi and Maharashtra, to return to the rolls. Electors who did not return their forms can do so now, explaining the delay, and those who moved within the State can return through the enumeration form with proof of their new address. EROs will process these forms under Rule 21(1) of the Registration of Electors Rules, 1960, and restore the elector’s old EPIC number. These “corrective” measures follow the Supreme Court’s observation on October 28 that forcing deleted electors to re-enrol through Form 6, meant for new voters, was an “error”. The ECI’s use of remedies that existed in the registration rules is a tacit admission that it went wrong during the SIR. But the measures are limited. They reach roughly 4.5 crore of the 13.37 crore struck off the draft rolls and do not cover electors who moved out of their States. Electors in States where the SIR has concluded, including Bihar and West Bengal, which have already voted on the SIR rolls, can return only through the SSR, by filing Form 6 as new voters, with fresh EPIC numbers and no record that they were ever on the roll. In essence, the structure of the SIR remains intact. Electors must still provide details from “the last SIR”, and those whose details are unavailable or do not match will be asked for documents in a manner that amounts to a citizenship test. The legality of the ludicrous “logical discrepancy” checks remains unaddressed. The 2002-03 special revision offered a better way. Those who had shifted homes were enumerated door to door at their new addresses. The Supreme Court must direct the ECI to return to that model.
• 3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: Election Commission of India / Special Intensive Revision of electoral rolls / election / India

fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: Europe must be part of any settlement on the Ukraine war

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: The trilateral negotiations in Abu Dhabi between Russia, Ukraine and the U.S. earlier this month failed to produce a major breakthrough or bridge the wide gap between Kyiv and Moscow. Yet, they were a good beginning towards finding a political settlement to Europe’s longest war since the Second World War . In the two-day talks, hosted by the U.S., the warring sides agreed on some humanitarian measures, including prisoner exchange. U.S. representatives Jared Kushner and Steve Witkoff met Russian President Vladimir Putin in Moscow after the talks to discuss the proposal. In the next stage, U.S., Ukrainian and European officials will meet in Berlin to discuss a coordinated European and Ukrainian position towards the peace process. As of now, Russian and Ukrainian positions remain far apart. Russia demands Ukraine withdraw from the territories of Donbas it still controls to stop attacks. Russia also wants to introduce limits to Ukrainian military capabilities and Kyiv to declare neutrality (give up its NATO ambitions). Ukraine, on the other hand, has rejected making any territorial concessions for a settlement and asked for security guarantees from the West so that Russia would not attack the country again. That Ukraine survived Russia’s invasion and continued to resist Russian forces for almost five years is no small feat. But it has also paid a huge price for its resistance. The country has lost more than 20% of its territory. Millions have fled, while men of fighting age are being drafted into the military . Ukraine’s economy is kept afloat by European support, while its military continues to rely on NATO for weapons and other supplies. Until recently, the West stood united in its support for Ukraine against Russia, but that unity has since begun to fray. U.S. President Donald Trump, who has lifted sanctions on Russian diesel, is seeking to reset Washington’s ties with Moscow . European leaders, who initially sought to isolate Russia, have also started reestablishing contacts with the Kremlin. In October, Finnish and Norwegian leaders held direct talks with Mr. Putin. To be sure, Ukraine’s long-range strikes can hurt Russia, as the recent attack on the Kerch Bridge demonstrated. But such strikes are unlikely to change the Kremlin’s thinking about the war. As the conflict drags on, Ukraine’s position is weakening, and its allies are growing increasingly divided. After almost five years, Russia has failed to take a decisive victory. Ukraine does not have a credible path towards victory either. A diplomatic settlement, therefore, is the only way forward. The Abu Dhabi talks recognised this reality. But for the process to be meaningful, Europe must also be brought to the negotiating table.
3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: World / Ukraine / USA / Russia-Ukraine Crisis / war / war

hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: देखिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का सीधा सा मतलब समझिये — दूसरी ओर, यूक्रेन ने समझौते के लिए कोई भी क्षेत्रीय रियायत देने से इनकार कर दिया है और पश्चिम से सुरक्षा गारंटी मांगी है ताकि रूस देश पर दोबारा हमला न करे।। नोट कर लीजिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का वर्ड 'Territorial' एग्जाम के लिए बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है! इसका अर्थ है: प्रादेशिक — इस अनुच्छेद में 'Territorial' का प्रयोग एक महत्वपूर्ण प्रशासनिक और विश्लेषणात्मक अर्थ में किया गया है। इसके Synonyms हैं: Comprehensive, Influential, Decisive और Antonyms हैं: Superficial, Ineffective, Fragile।

hinglishTracks.en: That Ukraine survived Russia’s invasion and continued to resist Russian forces for almost five years is no small feat.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: ज़रा ध्यान दीजियेगा, यहाँ मुख्य बात यह है कि — यूक्रेन रूस के आक्रमण से बच गया और लगभग पाँच वर्षों तक रूसी सेनाओं का विरोध करता रहा, यह कोई छोटी उपलब्धि नहीं है।।

hinglishTracks.en: But it has also paid a huge price for its resistance.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: आसान हिंग्लिश भाषा में इसे समझें तो — लेकिन इसने अपने प्रतिरोध की भारी कीमत भी चुकाई है।।

hinglishTracks.en: The country has lost more than 20% of its territory.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: देखिये, एग्जाम के नज़रिये से यह पॉइंट बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है — देश ने अपना 20% से अधिक क्षेत्र खो दिया है।। नोट कर लीजिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का वर्ड 'Territorial' एग्जाम के लिए बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है! इसका अर्थ है: प्रादेशिक — इस अनुच्छेद में 'Territorial' का प्रयोग एक महत्वपूर्ण प्रशासनिक और विश्लेषणात्मक अर्थ में किया गया है। इसके Synonyms हैं: Comprehensive, Influential, Decisive और Antonyms हैं: Superficial, Ineffective, Fragile।

hinglishTracks.en: Millions have fled, while men of fighting age are being drafted into the military .
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: चलिए, अब इस अगली लाइन का असली मतलब देखते हैं — लाखों लोग भाग गए हैं, जबकि लड़ने की उम्र के लोगों को सेना में शामिल किया जा रहा है।।

hinglishTracks.en: Ukraine’s economy is kept afloat by European support, while its military continues to rely on NATO for weapons and other supplies.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: देखिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का सीधा सा मतलब समझिये — यूक्रेन की अर्थव्यवस्था यूरोपीय समर्थन से चलती रहती है, जबकि इसकी सेना हथियारों और अन्य आपूर्ति के लिए नाटो पर निर्भर रहती है।।

hinglishTracks.en: Until recently, the West stood united in its support for Ukraine against Russia, but that unity has since begun to fray.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: ज़रा ध्यान दीजियेगा, यहाँ मुख्य बात यह है कि — हाल तक, पश्चिम रूस के ख़िलाफ़ यूक्रेन के समर्थन में एकजुट था, लेकिन तब से वह एकता ख़त्म होने लगी है।।

hinglishTracks.en: President Donald Trump, who has lifted sanctions on Russian diesel, is seeking to reset Washington’s ties with Moscow .
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: आसान हिंग्लिश भाषा में इसे समझें तो — राष्ट्रपति डोनाल्ड ट्रम्प, जिन्होंने रूसी डीजल पर प्रतिबंध हटा दिया है, मास्को के साथ वाशिंगटन के संबंधों को फिर से स्थापित करने की कोशिश कर रहे हैं।।

hinglishTracks.en: European leaders, who initially sought to isolate Russia, have also started reestablishing contacts with the Kremlin.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: देखिये, एग्जाम के नज़रिये से यह पॉइंट बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है — यूरोपीय नेता, जिन्होंने शुरू में रूस को अलग-थलग करने की कोशिश की थी, उन्होंने भी क्रेमलिन के साथ फिर से संपर्क स्थापित करना शुरू कर दिया है।।

hinglishTracks.en: In October, Finnish and Norwegian leaders held direct talks with Mr.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: चलिए, अब इस अगली लाइन का असली मतलब देखते हैं — अक्टूबर में, फिनिश और नॉर्वेजियन नेताओं ने श्री के साथ सीधी बातचीत की।।

hinglishTracks.en: To be sure, Ukraine’s long-range strikes can hurt Russia, as the recent attack on the Kerch Bridge demonstrated.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: देखिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का सीधा सा मतलब समझिये — निश्चित रूप से, यूक्रेन के लंबी दूरी के हमले रूस को नुकसान पहुंचा सकते हैं, जैसा कि केर्च ब्रिज पर हाल के हमले से पता चला है।।

hinglishTracks.en: But such strikes are unlikely to change the Kremlin’s thinking about the war.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: ज़रा ध्यान दीजियेगा, यहाँ मुख्य बात यह है कि — लेकिन इस तरह के हमलों से क्रेमलिन की युद्ध के बारे में सोच बदलने की संभावना नहीं है।।

hinglishTracks.en: As the conflict drags on, Ukraine’s position is weakening, and its allies are growing increasingly divided.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: आसान हिंग्लिश भाषा में इसे समझें तो — जैसे-जैसे संघर्ष बढ़ता जा रहा है, यूक्रेन की स्थिति कमज़ोर होती जा रही है और उसके सहयोगियों में फूट बढ़ती जा रही है।।

hinglishTracks.en: After almost five years, Russia has failed to take a decisive victory.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: देखिये, एग्जाम के नज़रिये से यह पॉइंट बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है — करीब पांच साल बाद रूस निर्णायक जीत हासिल करने में नाकाम रहा है.।

hinglishTracks.en: Ukraine does not have a credible path towards victory either.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: चलिए, अब इस अगली लाइन का असली मतलब देखते हैं — यूक्रेन के पास जीत की दिशा में कोई विश्वसनीय रास्ता भी नहीं है।।

hinglishTracks.en: A diplomatic settlement, therefore, is the only way forward.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: देखिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का सीधा सा मतलब समझिये — इसलिए, कूटनीतिक समझौता ही आगे बढ़ने का एकमात्र रास्ता है।। नोट कर लीजिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का वर्ड 'Settlement' एग्जाम के लिए बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है! इसका अर्थ है: बस्ती — इस अनुच्छेद में 'Settlement' का प्रयोग एक महत्वपूर्ण प्रशासनिक और विश्लेषणात्मक अर्थ में किया गया है। इसके Synonyms हैं: Comprehensive, Influential, Decisive और Antonyms हैं: Superficial, Ineffective, Fragile।

hinglishTracks.en: The Abu Dhabi talks recognised this reality.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: ज़रा ध्यान दीजियेगा, यहाँ मुख्य बात यह है कि — अबू धाबी वार्ता ने इस वास्तविकता को पहचाना।।

hinglishTracks.en: But for the process to be meaningful, Europe must also be brought to the negotiating table.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: आसान हिंग्लिश भाषा में इसे समझें तो — लेकिन इस प्रक्रिया को सार्थक बनाने के लिए यूरोप को भी बातचीत की मेज पर लाना होगा।।

✍️ Editorial & Opinion Paragraph #6 of 30 (23 NOV)

📰 Talks without peace: On Russia, Ukraine, U.S. talks

📌 Published: 23 Nov 2026, 07:28:59 PM IST
🎙️ Desi Hinglish Voice Educator • 🚂 Live Train Line Highlight & Screen Lock

1. Core Context & Background: Europe must be part of any settlement on the Ukraine war

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: The trilateral negotiations in Abu Dhabi between Russia, Ukraine and the U.S. earlier this month failed to produce a major breakthrough or bridge the wide gap between Kyiv and Moscow. Yet, they were a good beginning towards finding a political settlement to Europe’s longest war since the Second World War . In the two-day talks, hosted by the U.S., the warring sides agreed on some humanitarian measures, including prisoner exchange. U.S. representatives Jared Kushner and Steve Witkoff met Russian President Vladimir Putin in Moscow after the talks to discuss the proposal. In the next stage, U.S., Ukrainian and European officials will meet in Berlin to discuss a coordinated European and Ukrainian position towards the peace process. As of now, Russian and Ukrainian positions remain far apart. Russia demands Ukraine withdraw from the territories of Donbas it still controls to stop attacks. Russia also wants to introduce limits to Ukrainian military capabilities and Kyiv to declare neutrality (give up its NATO ambitions). Ukraine, on the other hand, has rejected making any territorial concessions for a settlement and asked for security guarantees from the West so that Russia would not attack the country again. That Ukraine survived Russia’s invasion and continued to resist Russian forces for almost five years is no small feat. But it has also paid a huge price for its resistance. The country has lost more than 20% of its territory. Millions have fled, while men of fighting age are being drafted into the military . Ukraine’s economy is kept afloat by European support, while its military continues to rely on NATO for weapons and other supplies. Until recently, the West stood united in its support for Ukraine against Russia, but that unity has since begun to fray. U.S. President Donald Trump, who has lifted sanctions on Russian diesel, is seeking to reset Washington’s ties with Moscow . European leaders, who initially sought to isolate Russia, have also started reestablishing contacts with the Kremlin. In October, Finnish and Norwegian leaders held direct talks with Mr. Putin. To be sure, Ukraine’s long-range strikes can hurt Russia, as the recent attack on the Kerch Bridge demonstrated. But such strikes are unlikely to change the Kremlin’s thinking about the war. As the conflict drags on, Ukraine’s position is weakening, and its allies are growing increasingly divided. After almost five years, Russia has failed to take a decisive victory. Ukraine does not have a credible path towards victory either. A diplomatic settlement, therefore, is the only way forward. The Abu Dhabi talks recognised this reality. But for the process to be meaningful, Europe must also be brought to the negotiating table.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: World / Ukraine / USA / Russia-Ukraine Crisis / war / war

प्रादेशिक — इस अनुच्छेद में 'Territorial' का प्रयोग एक महत्वपूर्ण प्रशासनिक और विश्लेषणात्मक अर्थ में किया गया है।

Settlement (Adjective)
बस्ती — इस अनुच्छेद में 'Settlement' का प्रयोग एक महत्वपूर्ण प्रशासनिक और विश्लेषणात्मक अर्थ में किया गया है।
✓ Syn: Comprehensive, Influential, Decisive  |  ✖ Ant: Superficial, Ineffective, Fragile
Trilateral (Adjective)
त्रिपक्षीय — इस अनुच्छेद में 'Trilateral' का प्रयोग एक महत्वपूर्ण प्रशासनिक और विश्लेषणात्मक अर्थ में किया गया है।
✓ Syn: Comprehensive, Influential, Decisive  |  ✖ Ant: Superficial, Ineffective, Fragile
Neutrality (Noun)
तटस्थता — इस अनुच्छेद में 'Neutrality' का प्रयोग एक महत्वपूर्ण प्रशासनिक और विश्लेषणात्मक अर्थ में किया गया है।
✓ Syn: Significant, Substantial, Strategic  |  ✖ Ant: Insignificant, Negligible, Trivial

Q1. Based on a critical reading of the above ✍️ Editorial & Opinion passage on "Talks without peace: On Russia, Ukraine, U.S. talks", which of the following statements accurately reflects the central analytical observation of the text?
A. Europe must be part of any settlement on the Ukraine war.
B. Contrary to the passage, the issue of 'Talks without peace: On Russia, Ukraine, U.S. ta' requires zero institutional or regulatory intervention at any level.
C. The passage argues that all empirical data and statutory mechanisms related to 'Talks without peace: On Russia, Ukraine, U.S.' should be permanently discontinued.
D. The author contends that 'Talks without peace: On Russia, Ukraine, U.S.' has no bearing on public governance, economy, or citizen welfare.
✅ Correct Answer: Option (A) — Sahi Jawab Option (A) hai. Is passage ki mukhya line saaf batati hai: "Europe must be part of any settlement on the Ukraine war." (Hinglish Arth: यूरोप को यूक्रेन युद्ध पर किसी भी समझौते का हिस्सा होना चाहिए)
Q2. Which of the following key analytical points or conclusions is explicitly highlighted by the author in the passage regarding "Talks without peace: On Russia, Ukraine, U.S. talks"?
A. Advocating complete policy paralysis and ignoring ground-level implementation challenges.
B. World / Ukraine / USA / Russia-Ukraine Crisis / war / war.
C. Dismissing constitutional accountability and relying solely on unverified short-term measures.
D. Recommending the immediate suspension of all regulatory and scientific assessments mentioned in the text.
✅ Correct Answer: Option (B) — Sahi Jawab Option (B) hai. Lekhak ne passage ke vishleshan mein is baat par zor diya hai: "World / Ukraine / USA / Russia-Ukraine Crisis / war / war." (Hinglish Arth: विश्व / यूक्रेन / अमेरिका / रूस-यूक्रेन संकट / युद्ध / युद्ध)

fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: Takshashila University conferred honorary doctorates upon Tamil author and screenwriter S. Ramakrishnan and playback singer K.S. Chithra at its second convocation held at Ongur in Tindivanam recently.

🏛️ Political, National & Polity Paragraph #7 of 30 (23 NOV)

📰 Takshashila University confers honorary doctorates on author S. Ramakrishnan and playback singer K.S. Chithra

📌 Published: 23 Nov 2026, 01:11:33 AM
🎙️ Desi Hinglish Voice Educator • 🚂 Live Train Line Highlight & Screen Lock

1. Core Context & Background: Takshashila University conferred honorary doctorates upon Tamil author and screenwriter S. Ramakrishnan and playback singer K.S. Chithra at its second convocation held at Ongur in Tindivanam recently.

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: According to a press note, the University awarded gold medals to 19 students and recognised 186 students who secured first class with distinction. In his address, M. Dhanasekaran, University Chancellor underscored the role of quality education, perseverance, discipline and moral values in shaping responsible citizens. In her address, Former United Nations-Habitat Executive Director Maimunah Mohd Sharif, spoke about inclusive governance, sustainability and women’s empowerment.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: Dr. Vivek Inder Kochhar, Vice-Chancellor and Pro-Chancellors D. Rajarajan and Dr. Nila Priyadarshini participated.

Inclusive (Adjective)

Sustainability (Noun)
सतत विकास — पर्यावरण और भविष्य की पीढ़ियों को नुकसान पहुँचाए बिना लंबे समय तक चलने वाला विकास।

✓ Syn: Significant, Substantial, Strategic  |  ✖ Ant: Insignificant, Negligible, Trivial
Convocation (Noun)
दीक्षांत समारोह — इस अनुच्छेद में 'Convocation' का प्रयोग एक महत्वपूर्ण प्रशासनिक और विश्लेषणात्मक अर्थ में किया गया है।
✓ Syn: Significant, Substantial, Strategic  |  ✖ Ant: Insignificant, Negligible, Trivial

fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: A 42-year-old man sustained minor injuries on his left thigh after being bitten by a crocodile that strayed into a house in Koppadi village near Chidambaram on Sunday.

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: According to police sources, P. Ilavarasan of Koppadi village was staying in his house when a dog began to bark continuously. When he went outside he was shocked to see a crocodile. The reptile lunged at him and attacked Ilavarasan on his left thigh. Hearing his cries, neighbours rushed to the spot and alerted the Forest Department.
3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: Forest Department personnel arrived and, with the help of residents, safely captured the crocodile and released it into the Vakkaramari lake in Chidambaram.

articles.title: Pattabiram residents urge Highways dept. to build roundabouton CTH Road junction
articles.examRelevance: GS Paper-II & Polity: Constitutional Amendments, Supreme Court Judgements, Parliamentary Bills & Governance Schemes
fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: Residents of Pattabiram have urged the Highways Department to build a roundabout on the Chennai–Tiruvallur High Road (CTH) or Chennai–Tirupati–Renigunta Road near the flyover, replacing the Level Crossing 2 on the railway siding.

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: Without a roundabout, the six-way junction presents a chaotic sight during peak hours, said Roy Rozario, a resident. Apart from the lanes of the C.T.H Road, road to/from Poonamallee and M.G. Road join the junction. People heading to the police station, TIDEL Park, hotels, schools, and colleges use the junction. “Due to the lack of a roundabout, a lot of accidents happen as people drive on the wrong side of the road or drive recklessly. Long ago, the government had announced that a roundabout would be constructedat the location. We hope that it would come up soon,” he added. Residents, meanwhile, have urged the department to open the other side of the flyover to traffic. “It has been completed. Only some works such as lighting, removal of excess cement concrete, and painting seem to remain. Though the surface is rough, people are driving on the incomplete side of the flyover to reach the other side,” said T. Sadagopan, activist. The space beneath the flyover must also be cleared and the roads must be laid properly. “Several bus services from Poonamallee, Thiruninravur, and other places have been cut, as there is no space to park the buses. Those buses that start from Pattabiram wait at random spots on the C.T.H Road. We want the Highways to also construct a foot overbridge beneath the flyover, or a limited-use subway,” said a resident.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: Sources said the roundabout would be formed during the widening of the road. As far as a subway or a foot overbridge was concerned, necessary studies would be taken up.

🏛️ Political, National & Polity Paragraph #9 of 30 (23 NOV)

📰 Pattabiram residents urge Highways dept. to build roundabouton CTH Road junction

📌 Published: 23 Nov 2026, 01:08:16 AM
🎙️ Desi Hinglish Voice Educator • 🚂 Live Train Line Highlight & Screen Lock

1. Core Context & Background: Residents of Pattabiram have urged the Highways Department to build a roundabout on the Chennai–Tiruvallur High Road (CTH) or Chennai–Tirupati–Renigunta Road near the flyover, replacing the Level Crossing 2 on the railway siding.

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: Without a roundabout, the six-way junction presents a chaotic sight during peak hours, said Roy Rozario, a resident. Apart from the lanes of the C.T.H Road, road to/from Poonamallee and M.G. Road join the junction. People heading to the police station, TIDEL Park, hotels, schools, and colleges use the junction. “Due to the lack of a roundabout, a lot of accidents happen as people drive on the wrong side of the road or drive recklessly. Long ago, the government had announced that a roundabout would be constructedat the location. We hope that it would come up soon,” he added. Residents, meanwhile, have urged the department to open the other side of the flyover to traffic. “It has been completed. Only some works such as lighting, removal of excess cement concrete, and painting seem to remain. Though the surface is rough, people are driving on the incomplete side of the flyover to reach the other side,” said T. Sadagopan, activist. The space beneath the flyover must also be cleared and the roads must be laid properly. “Several bus services from Poonamallee, Thiruninravur, and other places have been cut, as there is no space to park the buses. Those buses that start from Pattabiram wait at random spots on the C.T.H Road. We want the Highways to also construct a foot overbridge beneath the flyover, or a limited-use subway,” said a resident.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: Sources said the roundabout would be formed during the widening of the road. As far as a subway or a foot overbridge was concerned, necessary studies would be taken up.

✓ Syn: Significant, Substantial, Strategic  |  ✖ Ant: Insignificant, Negligible, Trivial
Location (Noun)
जगह — इस अनुच्छेद में 'Location' का प्रयोग एक महत्वपूर्ण प्रशासनिक और विश्लेषणात्मक अर्थ में किया गया है।
✓ Syn: Significant, Substantial, Strategic  |  ✖ Ant: Insignificant, Negligible, Trivial
Chaotic (Adjective)
अराजक — इस अनुच्छेद में 'Chaotic' का प्रयोग एक महत्वपूर्ण प्रशासनिक और विश्लेषणात्मक अर्थ में किया गया है।

✅ Correct Answer: Option (A) — Sahi Jawab Option (A) hai. articles.title: Six sent to juvenile home after Mumbai assault; Maharashtra SP leader seeks age change
articles.examRelevance: GS Paper-II & Polity: Constitutional Amendments, Supreme Court Judgements, Parliamentary Bills & Governance Schemes
fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: Police registered a case and produced all eight before the Board, and notices were sent to parents; the case was registered under sections 189(2), 189(4), 118(1), 352 and 351(2) of the Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita, 2023, says Deputy Commissioner of Police

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: A juvenile court in Mumbai on Saturday sent six minors to a juvenile correctional home till December 4 in connection with the alleged assault of a couple at a garden in Kurla on Friday evening, police said on Sunday. The six are aged between 12 and 15, the Ghatkopar police said. Deputy Commissioner of Police Ganesh Shinde said an FIR was lodged against the minors under Sections 189(2) (unlawful assembly), 118(1) (voluntarily causing hurt using dangerous weapons or means), 352 (intentional insult with intent to provoke breach of peace), and 351(2) (criminal intimidation) and other relevant provisions of the BNS. All of them were produced before the Juvenile Justice Board and notices were sent to their parents. According to the police, the couple was at the garden behind Phoenix Marketcity mall when a group of minors surrounded them and began to abuse them. When the couple tried to reason with the group, they assaulted them with a hockey stick and forced them out of the garden. Police detained them after a video of the incident surfaced on social media. The police said they are recording the statements of the couple and the juveniles to determine whether the two groups had a dispute before the incident that took place at the Pramod Mahajan Garden. The incident drew sharp reactions from political parties, with many condemning it. Samajwadi Party Maharashtra president Abu Asim Azmi said the juvenile age threshold should be brought down from 18 to 15 and that those below 18 years who commit murder, robbery or harassment should not be given concessions under the law. Mr. Azmi added that the incident should not be linked to religion and that the law should act without discrimination. Meanwhile, BJP leader Kirit Somaiya met the couple at the Ghatkopar police station and promised action. NCP (SP) MP Supriya Sule urged Chief Minister Devendra Fadnavis, who holds the Home portfolio, to “adopt a no-tolerance policy towards such incidents” and said citizens should be able to move around freely in the State. Shiv Sena (UBT) leader Intekhab Farooqui also condemned the assault.
3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: Mumbai / law / crime / police / Samajwadi Party / Bharatiya Janata Party / Shiv Sena

hinglishTracks.en: Police detained them after a video of the incident surfaced on social media.

hinglishTracks.en: The incident drew sharp reactions from political parties, with many condemning it.

hinglishTracks.en: Samajwadi Party Maharashtra president Abu Asim Azmi said the juvenile age threshold should be brought down from 18 to 15 and that those below 18 years who commit murder, robbery or harassment should not be given concessions under the law.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: देखिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का सीधा सा मतलब समझिये — समाजवादी पार्टी के महाराष्ट्र अध्यक्ष अबू आसिम आजमी ने कहा कि किशोर आयु सीमा को 18 से घटाकर 15 वर्ष किया जाना चाहिए और हत्या, डकैती या उत्पीड़न करने वाले 18 वर्ष से कम उम्र के लोगों को कानून के तहत रियायत नहीं दी जानी चाहिए।।

hinglishTracks.en: Azmi added that the incident should not be linked to religion and that the law should act without discrimination.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: ज़रा ध्यान दीजियेगा, यहाँ मुख्य बात यह है कि — आजमी ने कहा कि घटना को धर्म से नहीं जोड़ा जाना चाहिए और कानून को बिना भेदभाव के काम करना चाहिए।। नोट कर लीजिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का वर्ड 'Discrimination' एग्जाम के लिए बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है! इसका अर्थ है: भेदभाव — इस अनुच्छेद में 'Discrimination' का प्रयोग एक महत्वपूर्ण प्रशासनिक और विश्लेषणात्मक अर्थ में किया गया है। इसके Synonyms हैं: Restrictive, Counteractive, Adverse और Antonyms हैं: Constructive, Supportive, Favorable।

hinglishTracks.en: Meanwhile, BJP leader Kirit Somaiya met the couple at the Ghatkopar police station and promised action.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: आसान हिंग्लिश भाषा में इसे समझें तो — इस बीच, भाजपा नेता किरीट सोमैया ने घाटकोपर पुलिस स्टेशन में जोड़े से मुलाकात की और कार्रवाई का वादा किया।।

hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: देखिये, एग्जाम के नज़रिये से यह पॉइंट बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है — राकांपा (सपा) सांसद सुप्रिया सुले ने मुख्यमंत्री देवेन्द्र फड़णवीस, जिनके पास गृह विभाग है, से "ऐसी घटनाओं के प्रति सहन न करने की नीति अपनाने" का आग्रह किया और कहा कि नागरिकों को राज्य में स्वतंत्र रूप से घूमने में सक्षम होना चाहिए।।

hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: चलिए, अब इस अगली लाइन का असली मतलब देखते हैं — शिवसेना (यूबीटी) नेता इंतेखाब फारूकी ने भी हमले की निंदा की।।

🏛️ Political, National & Polity Paragraph #10 of 30 (23 NOV)

📰 Six sent to juvenile home after Mumbai assault; Maharashtra SP leader seeks age change

📌 Published: 23 Nov 2026, 01:04:02 AM
🎙️ Desi Hinglish Voice Educator • 🚂 Live Train Line Highlight & Screen Lock

1. Core Context & Background: Police registered a case and produced all eight before the Board, and notices were sent to parents; the case was registered under sections 189(2), 189(4), 118(1), 352 and 351(2) of the Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita, 2023, says Deputy Commissioner of Police

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: A juvenile court in Mumbai on Saturday sent six minors to a juvenile correctional home till December 4 in connection with the alleged assault of a couple at a garden in Kurla on Friday evening, police said on Sunday. The six are aged between 12 and 15, the Ghatkopar police said. Deputy Commissioner of Police Ganesh Shinde said an FIR was lodged against the minors under Sections 189(2) (unlawful assembly), 118(1) (voluntarily causing hurt using dangerous weapons or means), 352 (intentional insult with intent to provoke breach of peace), and 351(2) (criminal intimidation) and other relevant provisions of the BNS. All of them were produced before the Juvenile Justice Board and notices were sent to their parents. According to the police, the couple was at the garden behind Phoenix Marketcity mall when a group of minors surrounded them and began to abuse them. When the couple tried to reason with the group, they assaulted them with a hockey stick and forced them out of the garden. Police detained them after a video of the incident surfaced on social media. The police said they are recording the statements of the couple and the juveniles to determine whether the two groups had a dispute before the incident that took place at the Pramod Mahajan Garden. The incident drew sharp reactions from political parties, with many condemning it. Samajwadi Party Maharashtra president Abu Asim Azmi said the juvenile age threshold should be brought down from 18 to 15 and that those below 18 years who commit murder, robbery or harassment should not be given concessions under the law. Mr. Azmi added that the incident should not be linked to religion and that the law should act without discrimination. Meanwhile, BJP leader Kirit Somaiya met the couple at the Ghatkopar police station and promised action. NCP (SP) MP Supriya Sule urged Chief Minister Devendra Fadnavis, who holds the Home portfolio, to “adopt a no-tolerance policy towards such incidents” and said citizens should be able to move around freely in the State. Shiv Sena (UBT) leader Intekhab Farooqui also condemned the assault.

• 2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: A juvenile court in Mumbai on Saturday sent six minors to a juvenile correctional home till December 4 in connection with the alleged assault of a couple at a garden in Kurla on Friday evening, police said on Sunday. The six are aged between 12 and 15, the Ghatkopar police said. Deputy Commissioner of Police Ganesh Shinde said an FIR was lodged against the minors under Sections 189(2) (unlawful assembly), 118(1) (voluntarily causing hurt using dangerous weapons or means), 352 (intentional insult with intent to provoke breach of peace), and 351(2) (criminal intimidation) and other relevant provisions of the BNS. All of them were produced before the Juvenile Justice Board and notices were sent to their parents. According to the police, the couple was at the garden behind Phoenix Marketcity mall when a group of minors surrounded them and began to abuse them. When the couple tried to reason with the group, they assaulted them with a hockey stick and forced them out of the garden. Police detained them after a video of the incident surfaced on social media. The police said they are recording the statements of the couple and the juveniles to determine whether the two groups had a dispute before the incident that took place at the Pramod Mahajan Garden. The incident drew sharp reactions from political parties, with many condemning it. Samajwadi Party Maharashtra president Abu Asim Azmi said the juvenile age threshold should be brought down from 18 to 15 and that those below 18 years who commit murder, robbery or harassment should not be given concessions under the law. Mr. Azmi added that the incident should not be linked to religion and that the law should act without discrimination. Meanwhile, BJP leader Kirit Somaiya met the couple at the Ghatkopar police station and promised action. NCP (SP) MP Supriya Sule urged Chief Minister Devendra Fadnavis, who holds the Home portfolio, to “adopt a no-tolerance policy towards such incidents” and said citizens should be able to move around freely in the State. Shiv Sena (UBT) leader Intekhab Farooqui also condemned the assault.
• 3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: Mumbai / law / crime / police / Samajwadi Party / Bharatiya Janata Party / Shiv Sena

articles.title: Over 40% Group A posts vacant at PGIMS Rohtak, says former Minister
articles.examRelevance: GS Paper-II & Polity: Constitutional Amendments, Supreme Court Judgements, Parliamentary Bills & Governance Schemes
fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: Alleging that 41.6% of the sanctioned Group A posts at the Post-Graduate Institute of Medical Sciences (PGIMS) in Rohtak were lying vacant, former Haryana Home Minister Subhash Batra on Sunday questioned the BJP government’s claims of improving healthcare services in the State.

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: Citing an inspection by the Assembly’s Subject Committee in February, Mr. Batra said 424 of the 1,018 sanctioned Group A posts at the institute were vacant. He said the shortage of doctors, specialists and healthcare staff was affecting patient care at the institute, which catered to over 8,000 patients daily in its outpatient department. Manjunath, in-charge of the Public Relations Department, PGIMS, did not respond to repeated calls and messages seeking his response to the former Minister’s allegations. Addressing a press conference, Mr. Batra also pointed out that only 200 of the 540 medicines on the government-approved list were available in the hospital store during the Health Minister’s inspection in April. Supply orders for 172 types of medicines and surgical materials were pending with companies, he alleged. Alleging that the “condition of the Radiology Department is also extremely concerning”, Mr. Batra said 10 of the 13 sanctioned faculty posts and nine of the 11 Senior Resident posts were vacant in the department, as per a September-October 2026 report. Of the nearly 500 patients advised ultrasound examinations daily, only 40% could undergo the test on the same day, he added. Questioning the gap between budgetary allocations and the availability of health care facilities, Mr. Batra said ₹1,232 crore had been allocated to the Pandit Bhagwat Dayal Sharma University of Health Sciences and PGIMS for 2026-27, an increase of ₹422 crore over the previous year, but patients continued to face shortages of medicines and delays in diagnostic tests. Mr. Batra also raised concerns over two incidents of ceiling plaster falling in the old hospital building in October. On behalf of the Congress, Mr. Batra demanded that all vacant posts be filled, medicine stocks and pending complaints be made public, diagnostic facilities expanded and old hospital buildings subjected to a safety audit.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: “The poor, labourers, farmers and the middle-class families in the State need doctors on time, essential medicines and quality treatment and not speeches and announcements,” he said, adding that the Congress would continue to raise this serious issue concerning health and hold the government accountable.

🏛️ Political, National & Polity Paragraph #11 of 30 (23 NOV)

📰 Over 40% Group A posts vacant at PGIMS Rohtak, says former Minister

📌 Published: 23 Nov 2026, 01:01:11 AM
🎙️ Desi Hinglish Voice Educator • 🚂 Live Train Line Highlight & Screen Lock

1. Core Context & Background: Alleging that 41.6% of the sanctioned Group A posts at the Post-Graduate Institute of Medical Sciences (PGIMS) in Rohtak were lying vacant, former Haryana Home Minister Subhash Batra on Sunday questioned the BJP government’s claims of improving healthcare services in the State.

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: Citing an inspection by the Assembly’s Subject Committee in February, Mr. Batra said 424 of the 1,018 sanctioned Group A posts at the institute were vacant. He said the shortage of doctors, specialists and healthcare staff was affecting patient care at the institute, which catered to over 8,000 patients daily in its outpatient department. Manjunath, in-charge of the Public Relations Department, PGIMS, did not respond to repeated calls and messages seeking his response to the former Minister’s allegations. Addressing a press conference, Mr. Batra also pointed out that only 200 of the 540 medicines on the government-approved list were available in the hospital store during the Health Minister’s inspection in April. Supply orders for 172 types of medicines and surgical materials were pending with companies, he alleged. Alleging that the “condition of the Radiology Department is also extremely concerning”, Mr. Batra said 10 of the 13 sanctioned faculty posts and nine of the 11 Senior Resident posts were vacant in the department, as per a September-October 2026 report. Of the nearly 500 patients advised ultrasound examinations daily, only 40% could undergo the test on the same day, he added. Questioning the gap between budgetary allocations and the availability of health care facilities, Mr. Batra said ₹1,232 crore had been allocated to the Pandit Bhagwat Dayal Sharma University of Health Sciences and PGIMS for 2026-27, an increase of ₹422 crore over the previous year, but patients continued to face shortages of medicines and delays in diagnostic tests. Mr. Batra also raised concerns over two incidents of ceiling plaster falling in the old hospital building in October. On behalf of the Congress, Mr. Batra demanded that all vacant posts be filled, medicine stocks and pending complaints be made public, diagnostic facilities expanded and old hospital buildings subjected to a safety audit.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: “The poor, labourers, farmers and the middle-class families in the State need doctors on time, essential medicines and quality treatment and not speeches and announcements,” he said, adding that the Congress would continue to raise this serious issue concerning health and hold the government accountable.

📚 TOP 4 HARD VOCABULARY WORDS EXTRACTED FROM THIS PARAGRAPH (TAP CARD FOR PICTURE & SYNONYMS):
Institutional (Adjective)
संस्थागत — देश की संवैधानिक या सरकारी संस्थाओं के नियमों और ढांचे से जुड़ा हुआ।
✓ Syn: Systemic, Organizational, Constitutional  |  ✖ Ant: Individual, Informal, Unorganized
Accountability (Noun)
जवाबदेही — अपने फैसलों और काम का जनता तथा संविधान को हिसाब देने की बाध्यता।
✓ Syn: Responsibility, Answerability, Liability  |  ✖ Ant: Immunity, Exemption, Irresponsibility
Availability (Noun)
उपलब्धता — इस अनुच्छेद में 'Availability' का प्रयोग एक महत्वपूर्ण प्रशासनिक और विश्लेषणात्मक अर्थ में किया गया है।
✓ Syn: Significant, Substantial, Strategic  |  ✖ Ant: Insignificant, Negligible, Trivial
Inspection (Adjective / Verb)
निरीक्षण — इस अनुच्छेद में 'Inspection' का प्रयोग एक महत्वपूर्ण प्रशासनिक और विश्लेषणात्मक अर्थ में किया गया है।
✓ Syn: Restrictive, Counteractive, Adverse  |  ✖ Ant: Constructive, Supportive, Favorable

D. The author contends that 'Over 40% Group A posts vacant at PGIMS Rohtak' has no bearing on public governance, economy, or citizen welfare.
✅ Correct Answer: Option (A) — Sahi Jawab Option (A) hai. articles.title: CMC honours essay, painting, quiz competition winners in Vellore
